WITH  Questions as (
  select
    DATEADD(m, DATEDIFF(m, 0,CreationDate), 0) as 'Date',
    (case when ClosedDate is null then 0 else 1 end) as ClosedQuestion
  from
    Posts
  where
    ParentId is null
    and CreationDate >= '1/1/2010'
)

select
  Date,
  PctClosed = 100 * sum(ClosedQuestion) / count(*)
from
  Questions
group by
  Date
order by

sql: WITH cte AS (SELECT p.owneruserid, u.reputation, CAST(u.reputation AS DECIMAL) / COUNT(p.id) AS "rep per post", COUNT(p.id) AS postcount, SUM(CASE posttypeid WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "question count", SUM(CASE posttypeid WHEN 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "answer count" FROM posts AS p INNER JOIN users AS u ON owneruserid = u.id WHERE u.id <> -1 /* Community user */ AND u.reputation <> 1 /* Suspended user */ GROUP BY owneruserid, u.reputation HAVING COUNT(p.id) > 100) SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "rep per post" NULLS FIRST) AS rank, owneruserid AS "user link", reputation AS "rep per post", postcount, "question count", "answer count" FROM cte ORDER BY "rep per post" NULLS FIRST, owneruserid NULLS FIRST
original:
WITH  CTE AS (
SELECT 
 p.OwnerUserID,
 u.Reputation,
 CAST(u.Reputation as Decimal) / Count(p.id) [Rep Per Post],
 Count(p.id) postCount,
 SUM(Case PostTypeID WHEN 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) [Question Count],
 SUM(Case PostTypeID WHEN 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) [Answer Count]
FROM
  posts P 
  INNER JOIN Users u
  ON OwnerUserID = u.id
WHERE
  u.id <> -1 --Community user
  and
  u.Reputation <> 1 --Suspended user

GROUP BY 
  OwnerUserID,
  u.Reputation
HAVING
  Count(p.id) > 100  
)
SELECT 
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY [Rep Per Post]) Rank,
    OwnerUserID [User Link],
    Reputation [Rep Per Post],
    postCount,
    [Question Count],
    [Answer Count]
FROM
  cte
ORDER BY 
  [Rep Per Post],
  OwnerUserID

sql: WITH total_users AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS tu_count FROM users), users_rep_x AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS ru_count FROM users AS u WHERE u.reputation > 1000) SELECT DISTINCT (SELECT tu_count FROM total_users) AS "total users", (SELECT ru_count FROM users_rep_x) AS "users rep > x", CAST((CAST((SELECT ru_count FROM users_rep_x) AS DECIMAL(10, 5)) / CAST(((SELECT tu_count FROM total_users) / 100) AS DECIMAL(10, 5))) AS DECIMAL(10, 5)) AS "repu of totu in %" FROM users AS u WHERE u.reputation > 2500

SELECT
  tu_count = Count(*)
FROM
  Users
)
, users_rep_x AS (
SELECT
  ru_count = COUNT(*) 
FROM
  Users u
WHERE
  u.Reputation > 1000
)
SELECT
  DISTINCT 
    (SELECT tu_count FROM total_users) AS [Total Users],
    (SELECT ru_count FROM users_rep_x) AS [Users Rep > X],
    CAST( ( CAST( ( SELECT ru_count FROM users_rep_x ) AS decimal(10,5) ) / CAST( ( ( SELECT tu_count FROM total_users ) / 100 ) AS decimal(10,5) ) ) AS decimal(10,5) ) AS [RepU of TotU in %]
FROM
  Users u
WHERE
  u.Reputation > 2500

sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.creationdate) AS "month", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.creationdate) AS "year", SUM(CASE r.posthistorytypeid WHEN 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed, SUM(CASE r.posthistorytypeid WHEN 11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reopen FROM posthistory AS e JOIN posthistory AS r ON r.postid = e.postid WHERE e.creationdate < r.creationdate AND (e.posthistorytypeid = 4 OR e.posthistorytypeid = 5) /* Edit */ AND r.posthistorytypeid IN (10, 11) /* Reopen */ GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.creationdate), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.creationdate) ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM e.creationdate) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM e.creationdate) NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  datepart(mm, e.CreationDate) as [month]
  ,datepart(yyyy, e.CreationDate) as [year]
  ,SUM(CASE r.PostHistoryTypeId WHEN 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) as Closed
  ,SUM(CASE r.PostHistoryTypeId WHEN 11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) as reopen
from
   PostHistory e 
   join PostHistory r on r.PostId=e.PostId
where
  e.CreationDate < r.CreationDate
  and (e.PostHistoryTypeId = 4 or e.PostHistoryTypeId = 5) -- Edit
  and r.PostHistoryTypeId in (10,11)  -- Reopen
group by
  datepart(mm, e.CreationDate)
  ,datepart(yyyy, e.CreationDate)
 order by 
  datepart(yyyy, e.CreationDate)
  ,datepart(mm, e.CreationDate)

sql: SELECT num.tagname AS tag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rate.rate DESC NULLS LAST) AS mayrank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY num.num DESC NULLS LAST) AS totalrank, rate.rate AS questionsinmay, num.num AS questionstotal FROM (SELECT COUNT(postid) AS rate, tagname FROM tags, posttags, posts WHERE tags.id = posttags.tagid AND posts.id = postid AND posts.creationdate < '2012-12-01' AND posts.creationdate > '2012-12-31' GROUP BY tagname) AS rate INNER JOIN (SELECT COUNT(postid) AS num, tagname FROM tags, posttags, posts WHERE tags.id = posttags.tagid AND posts.id = postid GROUP BY tagname HAVING COUNT(postid) > 800) AS num ON rate.tagname = num.tagname ORDER BY rate.rate DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT  
       num.TagName as Tag,
       row_number() over (order by rate.Rate desc) as MayRank,
       row_number() over (order by num.Num desc) as TotalRank,
       rate.Rate as QuestionsInMay,
       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
and Posts.CreationDate < '2012-12-01'
and Posts.CreationDate > '2012-12-31'
group by TagName) as rate

INNER JOIN

(SELECT count(PostId) as Num, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
group by TagName
having count(PostId) > 800)
as num ON rate.TagName = num.TagName
order by rate.rate desc
;

sql: WITH commenttimes AS (SELECT c.creationdate, LAG(c.creationdate, 1, p.creationdate) OVER (PARTITION BY p.id ORDER BY c.id NULLS FIRST) AS previousitemdate FROM comments AS c JOIN posts AS p ON c.postid = p.id) SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) AS "month", AVG(CAST(CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(previousitemdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 3600 AS BIGINT) AS BIGINT)) AS "delayhours" FROM commenttimes GROUP BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) ORDER BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) NULLS FIRST
original:
WITH  CommentTimes as (
  select
    c.CreationDate, 
    lag(c.CreationDate, 1, p.CreationDate)
      over (partition by p.id order by c.id) as PreviousItemDate
  from comments c
  join posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
)
select 
  dateadd(month, datediff(month, 0, CreationDate),0) as [Month],
  AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(hour, PreviousItemDate, CreationDate ) AS BigInt)) [DelayHours]
from CommentTimes
GROUP BY
  dateadd(month, datediff(month, 0, CreationDate),0)
ORDER BY dateadd(month, datediff(month, 0, CreationDate),0)

sql: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) AS "answer delta", SUM(CASE WHEN q_u.lastaccessdate >= a.creationdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "last access after answer", SUM(CASE WHEN q_u.lastaccessdate < a.creationdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "last access before answer" FROM posts AS q INNER JOIN posts AS a ON q.id = a.parentid INNER JOIN users AS q_u ON q.owneruserid = q_u.id WHERE q.posttypeid = 1 /* Question */ AND a.posttypeid = 2 /* Answer */ AND CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) >= 0 /* Excludes the wombats http://meta.stackoverflow.com/q/98816/148672 and merges */ GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) ORDER BY CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT  
DateDiff(day,q.CreationDate,  a.CreationDate) 'Answer Delta',
SUM(CASE WHEN q_u.LastAccessDate >= a.CreationDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as 'Last Access After Answer',
SUM(CASE WHEN q_u.LastAccessDate < a.CreationDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as 'Last Access Before Answer'
   
FROM
  posts q
  INNER JOIN posts a
  ON q.Id = a.ParentId
  INNER JOIN Users q_u
  ON q.OwnerUserID = q_u.Id
  
WHERE
  q.PostTypeID = 1 --Question
  and
  a.PostTypeID = 2 --Answer
  and DateDiff(day,q.CreationDate,  a.CreationDate) >=0 
  --Excludes the wombats http://meta.stackoverflow.com/q/98816/148672 and merges
GROUP BY DateDiff(day,q.CreationDate,  a.CreationDate) 
ORDER BY DateDiff(day,q.CreationDate,  a.CreationDate)

  p.Score as [Score],
  p.Id as [Post Link],
  o.Reputation as [Rep], 
  o.Id as [User Link]
FROM Posts p
INNER JOIN Users o ON
  o.Id = p.OwnerUserId

  LEN(p.Body) < 500 AND
  LOWER(p.Body) LIKE '%check%' AND
  LOWER(p.Body) LIKE '%this%' AND
  LOWER(p.Body) LIKE '%answer%' AND

  p.Id,
  p.Body,
  p.Score,
  o.Id,
  o.Reputation

  )

WITH  USER_BY_TAG
AS
(
  SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) Rank,u.Reputation,
    u.Id AS [User Link], 
    COUNT(*) AS UpVotes
  FROM Tags t
      INNER JOIN PostTags pt ON pt.TagId = t.id
      INNER JOIN Posts     p ON p.ParentId = pt.PostId
      INNER JOIN Votes     v ON v.PostId = p.Id and VoteTypeId = 2
      INNER JOIN Users     u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
  WHERE 
      LOWER(Location) LIKE '%myanmar%'
  GROUP BY u.id,u.Reputation

)

SELECT * FROM USER_BY_TAG WHERE rank <= 1000 ORDER BY upvotes DESC ;

sql: SELECT h.userid AS "user link", SUM(CASE WHEN h.posthistorytypeid = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "retags", SUM(CASE WHEN h.posthistorytypeid = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "body edits", SUM(CASE WHEN h.posthistorytypeid = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "title edits", COUNT(DISTINCT h.creationdate) AS "total edits", COUNT(DISTINCT h.postid) AS "total edited posts" FROM posthistory AS h, posts AS p WHERE p.id = h.postid AND (h.posthistorytypeid = 4 OR h.posthistorytypeid = 5 OR h.posthistorytypeid = 6) AND h.userid <> p.owneruserid AND (p.communityowneddate IS NULL OR h.creationdate < p.communityowneddate) GROUP BY h.userid ORDER BY "total edited posts" DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT 
  h.UserId AS [User Link],
  Sum(Iif(h.PostHistoryTypeId = 6, 1, 0)) AS [Retags],
  Sum(Iif(h.PostHistoryTypeId = 5, 1, 0)) AS [Body edits],
  Sum(Iif(h.PostHistoryTypeId = 4, 1, 0)) AS [Title edits],
  Count(DISTINCT h.CreationDate) AS [Total edits],
  Count(DISTINCT h.PostId) AS [Total edited posts]
FROM PostHistory h, Posts p
WHERE p.Id = h.PostId
  AND (h.PostHistoryTypeId = 4 OR h.PostHistoryTypeId = 5 OR h.PostHistoryTypeId = 6)
  AND h.UserId <> p.OwnerUserId
  AND (p.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL OR h.CreationDate < p.CommunityOwnedDate)
GROUP BY h.UserId
ORDER BY [Total edited posts] DESC

sql: WITH multibadgeholders AS (SELECT userid, name, date FROM badges WHERE userid IN (SELECT userid FROM badges WHERE name = '1' INTERSECT SELECT userid FROM badges WHERE name = '1' INTERSECT SELECT userid FROM badges WHERE name = '1') AND name IN ('1', '1', '1')), allholdersbadges AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY userid, name ORDER BY date ASC NULLS FIRST) AS row FROM multibadgeholders), results AS (SELECT userid, name, date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY userid ORDER BY date DESC NULLS LAST) AS row FROM allholdersbadges WHERE allholdersbadges.row = 1) SELECT userid AS "user link", name AS "last badge name", date FROM results WHERE results.row = 1 ORDER BY date ASC NULLS FIRST

WITH  MultiBadgeHolders AS 
(
 SELECT UserId,Name,Date From Badges
 WHERE UserId IN 
 (
  SELECT UserId FROM Badges WHERE Name='##BadgeName1##'
  INTERSECT
  SELECT UserId FROM Badges WHERE Name='##BadgeName2##'
  INTERSECT
  SELECT UserId FROM Badges WHERE Name='##BadgeName3##'
 )
 AND Name IN ('##BadgeName1##','##BadgeName2##','##BadgeName3##') 
),
AllHoldersBadges AS 
(
 SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserId,Name ORDER BY Date ASC) AS Row 
 FROM MultiBadgeHolders
),
Results AS
(
 SELECT UserId,Name,Date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserId ORDER BY Date DESC) AS Row 
 FROM AllHoldersBadges WHERE AllHoldersBadges.Row=1
)

FROM Results 
WHERE Results.Row=1
ORDER BY Date ASC

sql: SELECT p.id AS "post link", MAX(c.creationdate) AS "last commented", MAX(ph.creationdate) AS "last op edit", MAX(p.closeddate) AS "closed" FROM comments AS c JOIN posts AS p ON c.postid = p.id AND c.userid <> p.owneruserid AND p.lasteditdate > c.creationdate JOIN posthistory AS ph ON p.id = ph.postid AND p.owneruserid = ph.userid AND ph.creationdate > c.creationdate JOIN votes AS v ON p.id = v.postid AND v.creationdate < ph.creationdate WHERE c.userid = 1 AND p.posttypeid = 1 AND ph.posthistorytypeid = 5 AND v.votetypeid = 3 GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY MAX(ph.creationdate) DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT  p.id as [Post Link]
     , max(c.creationdate) as [Last Commented]
     , max(ph.creationdate) as [Last OP Edit]
     , max(p.closeddate) as [Closed]
  from comments c
  join posts p
    on c.postid = p.id
   and c.userid <> p.owneruserid
   and p.lasteditdate > c.creationdate
  join posthistory ph
    on p.id = ph.postid
   and p.owneruserid = ph.userid
   and ph.creationdate > c.creationdate
  join votes v
    on p.id = v.postid
   and v.creationdate < ph.creationdate
 where c.userid = ##userid##
   and p.posttypeid = 1
   and ph.posthistorytypeid = 5
   and v.votetypeid = 3
 group by p.id
 order by max(ph.creationdate) desc

    SELECT Id
           , TagName
           , Count
           , RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Count DESC, TagName) AS CountRank
        FROM Tags

         , B.Id AS BId, B.TagName AS BTagName, B.Count AS BCount
        FROM TagsAndRanks AS A, TagsAndRanks AS B

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1900) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1) AS month, COUNT(*) AS q FROM tags LEFT JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id LEFT JOIN posts ON posts.id = posttags.postid LEFT JOIN posttypes ON posttypes.id = posts.posttypeid WHERE tags.tagname IN ('primefaces') AND posttypes.name = 'Question' AND posts.creationdate /* Exclude the current month */ < CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST
original:

  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  COUNT(*) AS Q

FROM Tags
  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

WHERE
  Tags.TagName IN ('primefaces') AND
  
  PostTypes.Name = 'Question' AND
  
  -- Exclude the current month
  Posts.CreationDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

GROUP BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate)

ORDER BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate)

sql: SELECT p.id AS "post link", p.id AS "post id", score AS "votes", viewcount AS "views", CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(p.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) AS age, p.viewcount / (CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(p.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) + 1) AS "view rate" FROM posts AS p WHERE p.viewcount > 280 AND /* On Stack Overflow there are 100 non-CW post with more than about 28000. */ p.communityowneddate IS NULL AND /* Field CommunityOwnedDate is absent for non-CW posts. */ p.viewcount / (CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(p.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) + 1) > 5 AND p.tags LIKE '%<.net-core>%' /* '%<java>%' also matches "'javascript'" (after "p.Tags" ): 'LIKE %java%'. Does not work for exact match: "COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CS_AS" */ /* ViewCount / age > */ ORDER BY "view rate" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

    p.Id as [Post Link],
    p.Id as [Post ID],
    Score as [Votes],
    ViewCount as [Views],
    DATEDIFF(day, p.CreationDate, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) as Age,
    p.ViewCount / (DATEDIFF(day, p.CreationDate, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) + 1) as [View rate]
FROM Posts p
WHERE p.ViewCount > 280 AND  -- On Stack Overflow there are 100 non-CW post with more than about 28000.
      p.CommunityOwnedDate is null AND  -- Field CommunityOwnedDate is absent for non-CW posts.
      p.ViewCount / (DATEDIFF(day, p.CreationDate, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) + 1) > 5 AND
      p.Tags LIKE '%<.net-core>%'  -- '%<java>%' also matches "'javascript'" (after "p.Tags" ): 'LIKE %java%'. Does not work for exact match: "COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CS_AS"
      -- ViewCount / age >
ORDER BY [View Rate] DESC

sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)) AS "year", EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)) AS "month", t.tagname, AVG(answercount) AS averageanswersperquestion, SUM(viewcount) / COUNT(p.id) AS averagenewquestionviews, COUNT(p.id) AS newquestioncount, SUM(viewcount) AS newqviewcount FROM posts AS p JOIN posttypes AS pt ON p.posttypeid = pt.id JOIN posttags AS ptg ON ptg.postid = p.id JOIN tags AS t ON t.id = ptg.tagid WHERE (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)) >= 2014 OR (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)) = 2013 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)) = 12)) AND pt.name = 'Question' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)), t.tagname HAVING (SUM(viewcount) >= 10000 OR SUM(viewcount) / COUNT(p.id) >= 2000 OR SUM(viewcount) / COUNT(p.id) >= 2000) ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, t.tagname NULLS FIRST

  month(creationdate) AS [month],
  t.TagName,

  count(p.id) as NewQuestionCount,

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(posts.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(posts.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) AS startofmonth, COUNT(DISTINCT posts.id) AS questions, COUNT(*) AS upvotes, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(*) / CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT posts.id) AS DECIMAL) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS upvotesperquestion, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN votes.postid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT posts.id) AS DECIMAL) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS postswithoutvotes FROM tags JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id JOIN posts ON posts.parentid = posttags.postid LEFT JOIN votes ON votes.postid = posts.id AND votetypeid = 2 WHERE tagname = 'postgresql' GROUP BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(posts.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(posts.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) ORDER BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(posts.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(posts.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
      DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, Posts.CreationDate), 0) AS StartOfMonth,
      count(distinct Posts.Id) as Questions,
      COUNT(*) AS UpVotes,
      round(count(*) / cast(count(distinct Posts.Id) as numeric), 2) as UpVotesPerQuestion,
      round(sum(case when Votes.PostId is null then 1 else 0 end) /  
        cast(count(distinct Posts.Id) as numeric), 2) as PostsWithoutVotes
  FROM 
      Tags
      JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.id
      JOIN Posts ON Posts.ParentId = PostTags.PostId 
      left JOIN Votes ON Votes.PostId = Posts.Id and VoteTypeId = 2
  where
     TagName = 'postgresql'
  group by
    DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, Posts.CreationDate), 0)
  order by
    DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, Posts.CreationDate), 0)

   SELECT DISTINCT UpVotes, DownVotes, Id, Reputation
   FROM Users
   WHERE Reputation != 101 AND Reputation != 1 --Exclude users WITHout repchanges
   )

    Users.Id as [UserLink],
    Users.DisplayName as [SortName],
    Voters.Upvotes * 8 as [EstimatedAddedRep], 
    --as there is no split between question and answer votes
    -- we take 8 as median in accordance to the tendency that there are more

ORDER BY EstimatedAddedRep DESC

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1900) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1) AS month, tags.tagname, COUNT(*) AS questions FROM tags LEFT JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id LEFT JOIN posts ON posts.id = posttags.postid LEFT JOIN posttypes ON posttypes.id = posts.posttypeid WHERE tags.tagname IN ('couchbase', 'mongodb', 'cassandra', 'riak', 'couchdb') AND posttypes.name = 'Question' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), tags.tagname ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, tags.tagname NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  Tags.TagName,
  COUNT(*) AS Questions

FROM Tags
  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

WHERE
  Tags.TagName IN (
    'couchbase', 'mongodb', 'cassandra', 'riak', 'couchdb'
  ) AND
  
  PostTypes.Name = 'Question'
GROUP BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

ORDER BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

sql: SELECT CAST(TO_CHAR('1900-01-01' || INTERVAL '1 DAY' * COALESCE(se.week, closure.week) * 7, 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH24:MI:SS.US') AS VARCHAR(10)) AS "week from", COUNT(se.duration) AS "#se", ROUND(CAST(AVG(se.duration / 60.0) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS "δse", COUNT(closure.duration) AS "#close", ROUND(CAST(AVG(closure.duration / 60.0) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS "δclose" FROM (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(rt.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) / 7 AS "week", CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(rt.deletiondate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(rt.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) AS BIGINT) AS "duration" FROM reviewtasks AS rt WHERE rt.reviewtasktypeid = 1) AS se FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(rt.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) / 7 AS "week", CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(rt.deletiondate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(rt.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) AS BIGINT) AS "duration" FROM reviewtasks AS rt WHERE rt.reviewtasktypeid = 2) AS closure ON closure.week = se.week GROUP BY COALESCE(se.week, closure.week) ORDER BY "week from" ASC NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  Convert(varchar(10), DateAdd(Day, Coalesce(SE.week, Closure.week) * 7, '1900-01-01'), 126) AS [Week from],
  Count(SE.duration) AS [#SE],
  Round(Avg(SE.duration / 60.0), 1) AS [ΔSE],
  Count(Closure.duration) AS [#Close],
  Round(Avg(Closure.duration / 60.0), 1) AS [ΔClose]
FROM (
  SELECT
    DateDiff(Day, 0, RT.CreationDate) / 7 AS [week],
    DateDiff(Second, RT.CreationDate, RT.DeletionDate) AS [duration]
  FROM ReviewTasks RT
  WHERE RT.ReviewTaskTypeId = 1
) SE
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT
    DateDiff(Day, 0, RT.CreationDate) / 7 AS [week],
    DateDiff(Second, RT.CreationDate, RT.DeletionDate) AS [duration]
  FROM ReviewTasks RT
  WHERE RT.ReviewTaskTypeId = 2
) Closure ON Closure.week = SE.week
GROUP BY Coalesce(SE.week, Closure.week)
ORDER BY [Week from] ASC

sql: SELECT churn.cyear, churn.cmonth, totalusers, churn.churnusers, (1.0 * churn.churnusers / totalusers) AS percentage FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)) AS cyear, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)) AS cmonth, COUNT(id) AS churnusers FROM users WHERE creationdate < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'+ INTERVAL '-1 MONTH' AND CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(lastaccessdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(lastaccessdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) < 1 GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE))) AS churn JOIN (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)) AS cyear, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)) AS cmonth, COUNT(id) AS totalusers FROM users GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE))) AS total ON churn.cyear = total.cyear AND churn.cmonth = total.cmonth ORDER BY 1 NULLS FIRST, 2 NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT  churn.cYear, churn.cMonth, totalUsers, churn.churnUsers, (1.0 * churn.churnUsers / totalUsers) as percentage 
FROM 
  (SELECT YEAR(CreationDate) as cYear, Month(CreationDate) cMonth, COUNT(id) as churnUsers
  FROM Users
  WHERE CreationDate < DATEADD(month, -##months##, GETDATE())
        AND DATEDIFF(month, CreationDate, LastAccessDate) < ##months##
        GROUP BY YEAR(CreationDate), Month(CreationDate) ) as churn
JOIN 
  (SELECT YEAR(CreationDate) as cYear, Month(CreationDate) cMonth, COUNT(id) as totalUsers
  FROM Users
  GROUP BY YEAR(CreationDate), Month(CreationDate)) as total
ON churn.cYear = total.cYear AND churn.cMonth = total.cMonth
ORDER BY 1,2

sql: SELECT CAST(TO_CHAR(votes.creationdate, 'YYYYMMDD') AS VARCHAR(30)) AS "date", SUM(CASE WHEN posttypeid = 1 AND votetypeid = 1 THEN 2 WHEN posttypeid = 1 AND votetypeid = 2 THEN 5 WHEN posttypeid = 2 AND votetypeid = 1 THEN 15 WHEN posttypeid = 2 AND votetypeid = 2 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) AS "reputation earned", SUM(CASE WHEN votetypeid = 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "bounties offered" FROM votes LEFT OUTER JOIN posts ON votes.postid = posts.id WHERE (owneruserid = 1 OR userid = 1) AND (votetypeid = 1 OR votetypeid = 2 OR votetypeid = 8) AND (posttypeid = 1 OR posttypeid = 2 OR votetypeid = 8) GROUP BY CAST(TO_CHAR(votes.creationdate, 'YYYYMMDD') AS VARCHAR(30)) ORDER BY "reputation earned" NULLS FIRST

       sum(case 
           when PostTypeId = 1 and VoteTypeId = 1 then 2
           when PostTypeId = 1 and VoteTypeId = 2 then 5
           when PostTypeId = 2 and VoteTypeId = 1 then 15
           when PostTypeId = 2 and VoteTypeId = 2 then 10
           else 0
       end) as [Reputation Earned],
       sum(case when VoteTypeId = 8 then 1 else 0 end) as [Bounties Offered]
       
from Votes

sql: WITH allquartiles(roundedlength, postscore, quartile) AS (SELECT (ROUND(LENGTH(CAST(body AS TEXT)), -3) + 0.5E3) AS roundedlength, score AS postscore, NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY ROUND(LENGTH(CAST(body AS TEXT)), -3) ORDER BY score NULLS FIRST) AS quartile FROM posts WHERE posttypeid = 2 AND LENGTH(CAST(body AS TEXT)) <= 20000 ORDER BY ROUND(LENGTH(CAST(body AS TEXT)), -3) NULLS FIRST, score NULLS FIRST LIMIT 100000) SELECT roundedlength, MAX(CASE quartile WHEN 1 THEN postscore END) AS "1", MAX(CASE quartile WHEN 2 THEN postscore END) AS "2", MAX(CASE quartile WHEN 3 THEN postscore END) AS "3", MAX(CASE quartile WHEN 4 THEN postscore END) AS "4" FROM allquartiles /* WHERE */ /* Quartile!=4 */ GROUP BY roundedlength ORDER BY roundedlength NULLS FIRST

WITH  
AllQuartiles(RoundedLength,PostScore,Quartile)
AS (
  SELECT TOP(##postsNo?100000##) 
  (ROUND(LEN(Body), -##logRound?3##) +0.5E##logRound?3##)
    AS RoundedLength,
  Score 
    AS PostScore,
  NTILE(4) OVER(PARTITION BY ROUND(LEN(Body), -##logRound?3##) ORDER BY Score) 
    AS Quartile
  FROM Posts
  WHERE 
    PostTypeId = 2 AND
    LEN(Body) <= ##maxLength?20000##
  ORDER BY
    ROUND(LEN(Body), -##logRound?3##),Score
)
SELECT 
  RoundedLength,
  MAX(CASE Quartile WHEN 1 THEN PostScore END) '1',
  MAX(CASE Quartile WHEN 2 THEN PostScore END) '2',
  MAX(CASE Quartile WHEN 3 THEN PostScore END) '3',
  MAX(CASE Quartile WHEN 4 THEN PostScore END) '4'
FROM 
  AllQuartiles
--WHERE
  --Quartile!=4
GROUP BY
  RoundedLength
ORDER BY
  RoundedLength

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(p.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(p.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) AS "creationdate", COUNT(CASE WHEN p.score < 0 AND NOT p.closeddate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "voted down and closed", COUNT(CASE WHEN p.score < 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "voted down", COUNT(CASE WHEN p.score = 0 AND NOT p.closeddate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "zero and closed", COUNT(CASE WHEN p.score = 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "ignored", COUNT(CASE WHEN p.score > 0 AND NOT p.closeddate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "voted up and closed", COUNT(CASE WHEN p.score > 0 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS "voted up", COUNT(p.id) AS total FROM posts AS p WHERE p.parentid IS NULL GROUP BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(p.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(p.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) ORDER BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(p.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(p.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) NULLS FIRST

  count(case when p.Score < 0 and p.ClosedDate is not null then 1 else null end) as [Voted down and closed],
  count(case when p.Score < 0 then 1 else null end) as [Voted down],
  count(case when p.Score = 0 and p.ClosedDate is not null then 1 else null end) as [Zero and closed],
  count(case when p.Score = 0 then 1 else null end) as [Ignored],
  count(case when p.Score > 0 and p.ClosedDate is not null then 1 else null end) as [Voted up and closed],
  count(case when p.Score > 0 then 1 else null end) as [Voted up],
  count(p.Id) as Total
from Posts p

group by DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, p.CreationDate), 0)
order by DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, p.CreationDate), 0)

    LEN(p.Body) AS BodyLength,
    p.ParentId,
    parentUser.DisplayName AS ParentOwner,

INNER JOIN

ON

INNER JOIN

ON

INNER JOIN

ON

sql: SELECT num.tagname AS tag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rate.rate DESC NULLS LAST) AS mayrank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY num.num DESC NULLS LAST) AS totalrank, rate.rate AS questionsinmay, num.num AS questionstotal FROM (SELECT COUNT(postid) AS rate, tagname FROM tags, posttags, posts WHERE tags.id = posttags.tagid AND posts.id = postid AND posts.creationdate < '2012-09-01' AND posts.creationdate > '2012-08-01' GROUP BY tagname) AS rate INNER JOIN (SELECT COUNT(postid) AS num, tagname FROM tags, posttags, posts WHERE tags.id = posttags.tagid AND posts.id = postid AND tags.tagname = 'dart' GROUP BY tagname HAVING COUNT(postid) > 800) AS num ON rate.tagname = num.tagname ORDER BY rate.rate DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT  
       num.TagName as Tag,
       row_number() over (order by rate.Rate desc) as MayRank,
       row_number() over (order by num.Num desc) as TotalRank,
       rate.Rate as QuestionsInMay,
       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
and Posts.CreationDate < '2012-09-01'
and Posts.CreationDate > '2012-08-01'
group by TagName) as rate

INNER JOIN

(SELECT count(PostId) as Num, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId and Tags.TagName = 'dart'
group by TagName
having count(PostId) > 800)
as num ON rate.TagName = num.TagName
order by rate.rate desc
;

sql: WITH total_users AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS tu_count FROM users), users_rep_x AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS ru_count FROM users AS u WHERE u.reputation < 1) SELECT DISTINCT (SELECT tu_count FROM total_users) AS "total users", (SELECT ru_count FROM users_rep_x) AS "users rep > x", CAST((CAST((SELECT ru_count FROM users_rep_x) AS DECIMAL(10, 5)) / CAST(((SELECT tu_count FROM total_users) / 100) AS DECIMAL(10, 5))) AS DECIMAL(10, 5)) AS "repu of totu in %" FROM users AS u WHERE u.reputation < 1

SELECT
  tu_count = Count(*)
FROM
  Users
)
, users_rep_x AS (
SELECT
  ru_count = COUNT(*) 
FROM

WHERE
  u.Reputation < ##RepMax##
)

  DISTINCT 
    (SELECT tu_count FROM total_users) AS [Total Users],
    (SELECT ru_count FROM users_rep_x) AS [Users Rep > X],
    CAST( ( CAST( ( SELECT ru_count FROM users_rep_x ) AS decimal(10,5) ) / CAST( ( ( SELECT tu_count FROM total_users ) / 100 ) AS decimal(10,5) ) ) AS decimal(10,5) ) AS [RepU of TotU in %]
FROM
  Users u

  u.Reputation < ##RepMax##

  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId

sql: WITH dates AS (SELECT a.id, q.creationdate AS qdate, a.creationdate AS adate FROM posts AS q, posts AS a WHERE q.id = a.parentid AND q.posttypeid = 1 /* question */ AND a.posttypeid = 2 /* answer */ AND a.owneruserid = 1), delays AS (SELECT id, CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(adate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(qdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 60 AS BIGINT) AS delay FROM dates) /* number of answer in the first hour vs. older */ SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN delay <= 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within15, SUM(CASE WHEN delay > 15 AND delay <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within30, SUM(CASE WHEN delay > 30 AND delay <= 45 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS within45, SUM(CASE WHEN delay > 45 AND delay <= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS withinhour, SUM(CASE WHEN delay > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS morethanhour FROM delays
original:
WITH  Dates as (
select a.Id,
       q.CreationDate as QDate, 
       a.CreationDate as ADate
from Posts q, Posts a
where q.Id = a.ParentId
  and q.PostTypeId = 1 -- question
  and a.PostTypeId = 2 -- answer
  and a.OwnerUserId = ##UserId##
), Delays as (
select Id, 
       DateDiff(minute, QDate, ADate) as Delay
from Dates
  )
 
  -- number of answer in the first hour vs. older
  select SUM(Case when Delay <= 15 then 1 else 0 end)  as WITHin15,
         SUM(Case when Delay > 15 and Delay <= 30 then 1 else 0 end)  as WITHin30,
         SUM(Case when Delay > 30 and Delay <= 45 then 1 else 0 end)  as WITHin45,
         SUM(Case when Delay > 45 and Delay <= 60 then 1 else 0 end)  as WITHinHour,
         SUM(Case when Delay > 60 then 1 else 0 end) as MoreThanHour
  from Delays

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1900) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1) AS month, tags.tagname, COUNT(*) AS questions FROM tags LEFT JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id LEFT JOIN posts ON posts.id = posttags.postid LEFT JOIN posttypes ON posttypes.id = posts.posttypeid WHERE tags.tagname IN ('twisted', 'tornado', 'cyclone', 'gevent') AND posttypes.name = 'Question' AND posts.creationdate /* Exclude the current month */ < CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), tags.tagname ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, tags.tagname NULLS FIRST

  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  Tags.TagName,
  COUNT(*) AS Questions

FROM Tags
  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

sql: SELECT num.tagname AS tag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rate.rate DESC NULLS LAST) AS mayrank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY num.num DESC NULLS LAST) AS totalrank, rate.rate AS questionsinmay, num.num AS questionstotal FROM (SELECT COUNT(postid) AS rate, tagname FROM tags, posttags, posts WHERE tags.id = posttags.tagid AND posts.id = postid AND posts.creationdate < '2014-07-01' AND posts.creationdate > '2014-08-01' GROUP BY tagname) AS rate INNER JOIN (SELECT COUNT(postid) AS num, tagname FROM tags, posttags, posts WHERE tags.id = posttags.tagid AND posts.id = postid GROUP BY tagname HAVING COUNT(postid) > 800) AS num ON rate.tagname = num.tagname ORDER BY rate.rate DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT  
       num.TagName as Tag,
       row_number() over (order by rate.Rate desc) as MayRank,
       row_number() over (order by num.Num desc) as TotalRank,
       rate.Rate as QuestionsInMay,
       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
and Posts.CreationDate < '2014-07-01'
and Posts.CreationDate > '2014-08-01'
group by TagName) as rate

INNER JOIN

(SELECT count(PostId) as Num, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
group by TagName
having count(PostId) > 800)
as num ON rate.TagName = num.TagName
order by rate.rate desc
;

WITH  TagNames as
(
  select 
    t.Id
  from Tags t
  inner join PostTags pt on pt.TagId = t.Id
  inner join Posts p on p.Id = pt.PostId and p.PostTypeId = 1
  where p.Id not in (
    select p2.Id
    from Posts p2
    inner join PostTags ptTarget on p2.Id = ptTarget.PostId
      and ptTarget.TagId = t.Id
    inner join PostTags ptNotTarget on p2.Id = ptNotTarget.PostId
      and ptTarget.TagId != t.Id
    )
  group by t.Id
)
select
  t.TagName,
  t.[Count]
from Tags t
inner join TagNames tn on t.Id = tn.Id
order by [count] asc, TagName asc

sql: SELECT num.tagname AS tag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rate.rate DESC NULLS LAST) AS mayrank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY num.num DESC NULLS LAST) AS totalrank, rate.rate AS questionsinmay, num.num AS questionstotal FROM (SELECT COUNT(postid) AS rate, tagname FROM tags, posttags, posts WHERE tags.id = posttags.tagid AND posts.id = postid AND posts.creationdate < '2014-10-01' AND posts.creationdate > '2014-09-01' GROUP BY tagname) AS rate INNER JOIN (SELECT COUNT(postid) AS num, tagname FROM tags, posttags, posts WHERE tags.id = posttags.tagid AND posts.id = postid GROUP BY tagname HAVING COUNT(postid) > 800) AS num ON rate.tagname = num.tagname ORDER BY rate.rate DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT  
       num.TagName as Tag,
       row_number() over (order by rate.Rate desc) as MayRank,
       row_number() over (order by num.Num desc) as TotalRank,
       rate.Rate as QuestionsInMay,
       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
and Posts.CreationDate < '2014-10-01'
and Posts.CreationDate > '2014-09-01'
group by TagName) as rate

INNER JOIN

(SELECT count(PostId) as Num, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
group by TagName
having count(PostId) > 800)
as num ON rate.TagName = num.TagName
order by rate.rate desc
;

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1900) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1) AS month, tags.tagname, COUNT(*) AS questions FROM tags LEFT JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id LEFT JOIN posts ON posts.id = posttags.postid LEFT JOIN posttypes ON posttypes.id = posts.posttypeid WHERE tags.tagname IN ('java-6', 'java-7', 'java-8') AND posttypes.name = 'Question' AND posts.creationdate /* Exclude the current month */ < CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), tags.tagname ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, tags.tagname NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  Tags.TagName,
  COUNT(*) AS Questions

FROM Tags
  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

WHERE
  Tags.TagName IN (
    'java-6', 'java-7', 'java-8'
  ) AND
  
  PostTypes.Name = 'Question' AND
  
  -- Exclude the current month
  Posts.CreationDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

GROUP BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

ORDER BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1900) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1) AS month, tags.tagname, COUNT(*) AS questions FROM tags LEFT JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id LEFT JOIN posts ON posts.id = posttags.postid LEFT JOIN posttypes ON posttypes.id = posts.posttypeid WHERE tags.tagname IN ('elastic-beanstalk', 'amazon-dynamodb', 'amazon-rds', 'amazon-cloudfront', 'amazon-sqs', 'amazon-sns', 'amazon-ebs', 'amazon-vpc', 'amazon-simpledb') AND posttypes.name = 'Question' AND posts.creationdate /* Exclude the current month */ < CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), tags.tagname ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, tags.tagname NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  Tags.TagName,
  COUNT(*) AS Questions

FROM Tags
  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

WHERE
  Tags.TagName IN (
    'elastic-beanstalk', 'amazon-dynamodb', 'amazon-rds', 'amazon-cloudfront', 'amazon-sqs', 'amazon-sns', 'amazon-ebs', 'amazon-vpc', 'amazon-simpledb'
  ) AND
  
  PostTypes.Name = 'Question' AND
  
  -- Exclude the current month
  Posts.CreationDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

GROUP BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

ORDER BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

sql: WITH firstquery AS (SELECT t.tagname, p.id, MIN(CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(p2.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(p.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 60 AS BIGINT)) AS timetakenperpost FROM posts AS p JOIN posts AS p2 ON p2.parentid = p.id JOIN posttags AS pt ON pt.postid = p.id JOIN tags AS t ON t.id = pt.tagid WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 AND p2.posttypeid = 2 AND CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(p2.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(p.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 60 AS BIGINT) < 35000 AND CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(p2.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(p.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 60 AS BIGINT) >= 0 AND t.tagname LIKE '%android%' GROUP BY t.tagname, p.id) SELECT r.tagname, AVG(r.timetakenperpost) AS timetaken, STDDEV(r.timetakenperpost) AS stdtimetaken, COUNT(*) AS nquestions FROM firstquery AS r GROUP BY r.tagname ORDER BY timetaken NULLS FIRST
original:
WITH  firstquery as
(select t.TagName, p.Id,
min(datediff(minute,p.creationdate, p2.creationdate)) as TimeTakenPerPost
from Posts p
  join Posts p2 on p2.ParentId = p.Id
  join PostTags pt on pt.PostId = p.Id
  join Tags t on t.Id = pt.TagId
where 
p.PostTypeId = 1
and p2.PostTypeId = 2
and datediff(minute,p.creationdate, p2.creationdate) < 35000
and datediff(minute,p.creationdate, p2.creationdate) >= 0
and t.TagName like '%android%'
group by t.TagName, p.Id)

select r.TagName, 
avg(r.TimeTakenPerPost) as TimeTaken, 
stdev(r.TimeTakenPerPost) as StdTimeTaken,
count(*) as nQuestions
from firstquery r
group by r.TagName
order by TimeTaken

sql: WITH cte AS (SELECT DISTINCT q.id AS "post link", COUNT(p.id) OVER (PARTITION BY q.id) AS "upvotedanswercount", COUNT(a.id) OVER (PARTITION BY q.id) AS totalanswers, q.score FROM posts AS q LEFT JOIN posts AS p ON q.id = p.parentid AND p.score >= 0 INNER JOIN posts AS a ON a.parentid = q.id WHERE q.score /* Question is upvoted */ >= 1) SELECT * FROM cte WHERE upvotedanswercount = 0 ORDER BY totalanswers DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT distinct
  q.Id AS [Post Link],
  COUNT(p.Id) over (partition by q.id) AS [UpVotedAnswerCount],
  count(a.id) over (partition by q.id) as totalAnswers,
  q.score
FROM
  Posts AS q
   left join posts p
     on q.id = p.parentid and p.score>=0
   inner join posts a
    on a.parentid = q.id
  where 
  -- Question is upvoted
  q.Score >= 1
  )
  select * from cte 
  where upvotedanswercount =0
  order by totalAnswers desc

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1900) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1) AS month, tags.tagname, COUNT(*) AS questions FROM tags LEFT JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id LEFT JOIN posts ON posts.id = posttags.postid LEFT JOIN posttypes ON posttypes.id = posts.posttypeid WHERE (tags.tagname = 'flex' OR tags.tagname = 'flex4' OR tags.tagname = 'flex4.5' OR tags.tagname = 'actionscript-3') AND tags.tagname = 'apache-spark' AND posttypes.name = 'Question' AND posts.creationdate /* Exclude the current month */ < CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), tags.tagname ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, tags.tagname NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  Tags.TagName,
  COUNT(*) AS Questions

FROM Tags
  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

WHERE
  (Tags.TagName = 'flex' OR 
  Tags.TagName = 'flex4' OR
  Tags.TagName = 'flex4.5' OR
  Tags.TagName = 'actionscript-3') AND
  Tags.TagName = 'apache-spark' AND
  
  PostTypes.Name = 'Question' AND
  
  -- Exclude the current month
  Posts.CreationDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

GROUP BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

ORDER BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

INNER JOIN

  ph.Id = q.Id

 and

  COUNT(pf.FlagTypeId) DESC

  SUM(Posts.FavoriteCount) as CommentCount,
  SUM(Posts.ViewCount) as ViewCount,

sql: SELECT tagname, COUNT(DISTINCT posts.id) AS "number of questions", (SELECT SUM(score) FROM tags AS tagsi INNER JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tagsi.id INNER JOIN posts ON posttags.postid = posts.id WHERE tagsi.tagname = tagso.tagname) AS "total score of all questions", COUNT(answers.id) AS "number of answers", SUM(answers.score) AS "total score of all answers" FROM tags AS tagso INNER JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tagso.id INNER JOIN posts ON posttags.postid = posts.id LEFT JOIN posts AS answers ON posts.id = answers.parentid GROUP BY tagname
original:
SELECT  
    TagName,
    COUNT(DISTINCT Posts.Id) AS "Number of questions",
    (SELECT SUM(Score) FROM Tags TagsI
                       INNER JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = TagsI.Id
                       INNER JOIN Posts ON PostTags.PostId = Posts.Id
                       WHERE TagsI.TagName = TagsO.TagName) AS "Total score of all questions",
    COUNT(Answers.Id) AS "Number of answers", SUM(Answers.Score) AS "Total score of all answers"
  
FROM Tags TagsO
     INNER JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = TagsO.Id
     INNER JOIN Posts ON PostTags.PostId = Posts.Id
     LEFT JOIN Posts Answers ON Posts.Id = Answers.ParentId

GROUP BY TagName

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) AS m, tagname, COUNT(*) FROM posttags AS pt JOIN posts AS q ON q.id = pt.postid JOIN tags AS t ON t.id = pt.tagid WHERE tagname IN ('arch-linux', 'centos', 'debian', 'fedora', 'gentoo', 'kali-linux', 'linux-mint', 'opensuse', 'rhel', 'ubuntu') AND q.creationdate > '20100701' AND q.creationdate < CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) GROUP BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT), tagname ORDER BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT  dateadd(month, datediff(month, 0, q.CreationDate), 0) m, TagName, count(*)
from PostTags pt
join Posts q on q.Id=pt.PostId
join Tags t on t.Id=pt.TagId
where TagName in ('arch-linux', 'centos', 'debian', 'fedora', 'gentoo', 'kali-linux', 'linux-mint', 'opensuse', 'rhel', 'ubuntu')
and q.CreationDate > '20100701'
and q.CreationDate < dateadd(month, datediff(month, 0, getdate()), 0)
group by dateadd(month, datediff(month, 0, q.CreationDate), 0), TagName
order by dateadd(month, datediff(month, 0, q.CreationDate), 0)

sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.posttypeid = 1 THEN 'Questions' ELSE 'Answers' END AS "post type" /* the kruft here is just for pretty output formatting */, CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 'Up Votes' ELSE 'Down Votes' END AS "vote type", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM posts AS p INNER JOIN votes AS v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.closeddate /* open questions only (roughly): */ IS NULL AND /* questions (1) and answers (2) only: */ (p.posttypeid = 1 OR p.posttypeid = 2) AND /* upvotes (2) and downvotes (3) only */ (v.votetypeid = 2 OR v.votetypeid = 3) GROUP BY p.posttypeid /* group into questions + answers and upvotes + downvotes for counting */, v.votetypeid
original:
SELECT 
  -- the kruft here is just for pretty output formatting
  IIF(p.PostTypeId = 1, 'Questions', 'Answers') AS [Post Type],
  IIF(v.VoteTypeId = 2, 'Up Votes', 'Down Votes') AS [Vote Type],
  COUNT(*) AS [Count]
FROM
  Posts p INNER JOIN Votes v ON p.Id = v.PostId
WHERE
  -- open questions only (roughly):
  p.ClosedDate IS NULL 
  -- questions (1) and answers (2) only:
  AND (p.PostTypeId = 1 OR p.PostTypeId = 2) 
  -- upvotes (2) and downvotes (3) only
  AND (v.VoteTypeId = 2 OR v.VoteTypeId = 3)

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1900) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1) AS month, tags.tagname, COUNT(*) AS questions FROM tags LEFT JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id LEFT JOIN posts ON posts.id = posttags.postid LEFT JOIN posttypes ON posttypes.id = posts.posttypeid WHERE tags.tagname IN ('karma-runner', 'phantomjs', 'mocha', 'jasmine', 'protractor') AND posttypes.name = 'Question' AND posts.creationdate /* Exclude the current month */ < CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), tags.tagname ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, tags.tagname NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  Tags.TagName,
  COUNT(*) AS Questions

FROM Tags
  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

WHERE
  Tags.TagName IN (
    'karma-runner', 'phantomjs', 'mocha', 'jasmine', 'protractor'
  ) AND
  
  PostTypes.Name = 'Question' AND
  
  -- Exclude the current month
  Posts.CreationDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

GROUP BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

ORDER BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

SELECT

notacceptedbetter, likeaccepted, acceptedbetter, total, totalscore 
from (
  SELECT a.owneruserid as userid, 
  sum(case when a.score > ap.score then 1 else 0 end) as notacceptedbetter,
  sum(case when a.score = ap.score then 1 else 0 end) as likeaccepted,
  sum(case when a.score <= ap.score then 1 else 0 end) as acceptedbetter,
  count(*) as total,
  sum(a.score) as totalscore
  from posts a
    join posts p on a.parentid = p.id
    join posts ap on p.acceptedanswerid = ap.id
  where 
    a.posttypeid = 2 --answers
    and ap.id <> a.id
  group by a.owneruserid
  ) answers
  join users u on answers.userid = u.id
  order by notacceptedbetter desc

  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,

  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

  Tags.TagName IN (

sql: SELECT max_upvotes, COUNT(*) AS num_of_questions FROM (SELECT question_id, answer_id, MAX(upvotes) AS max_upvotes FROM (SELECT posts.id AS answer_id, posts.parentid AS question_id, COUNT(*) AS upvotes FROM posts INNER JOIN votes ON posts.id = votes.postid WHERE posts.posttypeid = 2 AND /* is an Answer */ votes.votetypeid = 2 /* is an upvote, i.e upmod */ GROUP BY posts.id, posts.parentid) AS a GROUP BY question_id, answer_id) AS b GROUP BY max_upvotes ORDER BY max_upvotes NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT  max_upvotes, count(*) as num_of_questions FROM(
    SELECT question_id, answer_id, max(upvotes) as max_upvotes FROM(
        SELECT Posts.Id as answer_id, Posts.ParentId as question_id, count(*) as upvotes FROM 
        Posts INNER JOIN Votes ON Posts.Id=Votes.PostId
        WHERE 
            Posts.PostTypeId = 2 AND /* is an Answer */
            Votes.VoteTypeId = 2   /* is an upvote, i.e upmod */
        GROUP BY Posts.Id, Posts.ParentId
        ) a
    GROUP BY question_id, answer_id
    ) b
GROUP BY max_upvotes
ORDER BY max_upvotes

sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.creationdate) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p.creationdate) AS month, COUNT(*) AS questions, SUM(p.answercount) AS answers, SUM(p.score) AS questionupvotes, SUM(p.viewcount) AS "views", SUM(CASE WHEN p.score > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "upvotedquestions", SUM(CASE WHEN NOT p.acceptedanswerid IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "acceptedquestions" FROM posts AS p WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.tags LIKE '%qt%' AND p.creationdate >= '2015-01-01 00:00:00' AND p.creationdate < '2015-04-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.creationdate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p.creationdate) ORDER BY year NULLS FIRST, month NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  DATEPART(YEAR, p.CreationDate) as Year, DATEPART(MONTH, p.CreationDate) as Month, Count(*) as Questions,
  sum(p.AnswerCount) as Answers,
  sum(p.Score) as QuestionUpvotes,
  sum(p.ViewCount) as [Views],
  sum(case when p.Score > 1 then 1 else 0 end) as [UpvotedQuestions],
  sum(case when p.AcceptedAnswerId is not null then 1 else 0 end) as [AcceptedQuestions]
from Posts p
where p.PostTypeId=1 AND p.tags like '%qt%' AND p.CreationDate >= '2015-01-01 00:00:00' AND p.CreationDate < '2015-04-01 00:00:00'

sql: SELECT t.tagname, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 END) AS upvotes, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 END) AS downvotes, ROUND(CAST((CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS voteratio FROM votes AS v INNER JOIN posts AS p ON v.postid = p.id AND (v.votetypeid = 2 OR v.votetypeid = 3) AND v.creationdate >= CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS DATE) + INTERVAL '-30 DAY' INNER JOIN posttags AS pt ON pt.postid = p.parentid INNER JOIN tags AS t ON t.id = pt.tagid GROUP BY t.tagname HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 END) > 1000 ORDER BY voteratio ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 50
original:
SELECT  TOP 50
  t.TagName,
  COUNT( Case when v.VoteTypeId = 2 then 1 end) AS UpVotes,
  COUNT( Case when v.VoteTypeId = 3 then 1 end) AS DownVotes,
  ROUND((CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS float) / CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS float)), 2) AS VoteRatio
FROM Votes v
  INNER JOIN Posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id and (v.VoteTypeId = 2 or v.VoteTypeId=3) and v.CreationDate >= DATEADD(day, -30, convert(date, GETDATE()))
  INNER JOIN PostTags pt ON pt.PostId = p.ParentId
  INNER JOIN Tags t ON t.Id = pt.TagId
GROUP BY t.TagName
HAVING COUNT( Case when v.VoteTypeId = 3 then 1 end) > 1000
ORDER BY VoteRatio ASC

sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.creationdate) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p.creationdate) AS month, COUNT(1) AS totalvotes, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 END) AS upvotes, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 END) AS downvotes, CAST(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 100 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) AS DECIMAL(4, 2)) AS voteratio FROM votes AS v INNER JOIN posts AS p ON v.postid = p.id AND (v.votetypeid = 2 OR v.votetypeid = 3) AND v.creationdate >= CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS DATE) + INTERVAL '-30 DAY' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.creationdate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM p.creationdate) ORDER BY year NULLS FIRST, month ASC NULLS FIRST

  DATEPART(MONTH, p.CreationDate) as Month,
  COUNT(1) AS TotalVotes,
  COUNT( Case when v.VoteTypeId = 2 then 1 end) AS UpVotes,
  COUNT( Case when v.VoteTypeId = 3 then 1 end) AS DownVotes,
  CAST(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId = 3 THEN 100 ELSE 0 END) AS float) / CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN v.VoteTypeId = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS float) AS decimal(4,2)) AS VoteRatio

  INNER JOIN Posts p ON v.PostId = p.Id and (v.VoteTypeId = 2 or v.VoteTypeId=3) and v.CreationDate >= DATEADD(day, -30, convert(date, GETDATE()))

sql: WITH canon /* two left joins suffice on SO at the moment, doing three for luck */ AS (SELECT tags.id, count, tags.tagname AS otag, COALESCE(c.targettagname, b.targettagname, a.targettagname, tagname) AS tagname FROM tags LEFT JOIN tagsynonyms AS a ON (a.sourcetagname = tagname) LEFT JOIN tagsynonyms AS b ON (b.sourcetagname = a.targettagname) LEFT JOIN tagsynonyms AS c ON (c.sourcetagname = b.targettagname)) SELECT tagname, COUNT(*) AS closed, MAX(canon.count) AS questions, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / MAX(canon.count) AS percentclosed FROM posts AS p LEFT JOIN posttags AS pt ON p.id = pt.postid LEFT JOIN canon ON pt.tagid = canon.id WHERE posttypeid = 1 AND NOT closeddate IS NULL AND canon.count >= 1000 GROUP BY tagname ORDER BY CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / MAX(canon.count) DESC NULLS LAST
original:
WITH  canon as (
  select tags.id, count, tags.tagname as otag,
    COALESCE(c.targettagname, b.targettagname, a.targettagname, tagname) as tagname
  from tags
  left join tagsynonyms as a on(a.sourcetagname = tagname)
  left join tagsynonyms as b on(b.sourcetagname = a.targettagname)
  left join tagsynonyms as c on(c.sourcetagname = b.targettagname)
  -- two left joins suffice on SO at the moment, doing three for luck
)

select tagname, count(*) as closed, max(canon.Count) as questions,
  CAST(count(*) as float)/max(canon.Count) as percentclosed
from posts p
left join posttags pt on p.id = pt.postid
left join canon on pt.tagid = canon.id
where posttypeid = 1 and closeddate is not null and canon.Count >= 1000
group by tagname
order by CAST(count(*) as float)/max(canon.Count) desc

sql: SELECT id AS "post link", upvotes, downvotes, score, (upvotes + (AVG(upvotes) OVER ())) / (upvotes + downvotes + (AVG(upvotes + downvotes) OVER ())) AS br FROM (SELECT p.id, COUNT(CASE v.votetypeid WHEN 2 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS upvotes, COUNT(CASE v.votetypeid WHEN 3 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS downvotes, MAX(p.score) AS score FROM posts AS p INNER JOIN votes AS v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 GROUP BY p.id) AS innerquery ORDER BY br DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 50
original:
SELECT  TOP ##topn:int?50##
   Id AS [Post Link],upvotes,downvotes,Score,
   (upvotes+(AVG(upvotes)OVER()))/(upvotes+downvotes+(AVG(upvotes+downvotes)OVER())) AS br
FROM
(SELECT
  p.Id,COUNT(CASE v.VoteTypeId WHEN 2 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) as upvotes,
  COUNT(CASE v.VoteTypeId WHEN 3 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) as downvotes,
  MAX(p.Score) as Score
  FROM Posts p INNER JOIN Votes v ON p.Id=v.PostId
  WHERE p.PostTypeId=1
  GROUP BY p.Id
) innerQuery
ORDER BY br DESC

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1900) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1) AS month, tags.tagname, COUNT(*) AS questions FROM tags LEFT JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id LEFT JOIN posts ON posts.id = posttags.postid LEFT JOIN posttypes ON posttypes.id = posts.posttypeid WHERE tags.tagname IN ('dplyr', 'plyr', 'data.table', 'tidyr', 'data.frame') AND posttypes.name = 'Question' AND posts.creationdate /* Exclude the current month */ < CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), tags.tagname ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, tags.tagname NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  Tags.TagName,
  COUNT(*) AS Questions

FROM Tags
  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

WHERE
  Tags.TagName IN (
    'dplyr', 'plyr', 'data.table', 'tidyr', 'data.frame'
  ) AND
  
  PostTypes.Name = 'Question' AND
  
  -- Exclude the current month
  Posts.CreationDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

GROUP BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

ORDER BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

sql: SELECT creationdate, rev, userid AS "user link", comment, text FROM (/* first get all rows for a single post */ /* that reflect an edit */ /* to guarantee the revision nr is correct */ /* as it is dependant on the row_number */ SELECT creationdate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY creationdate ASC NULLS FIRST) AS rev, userid, comment, text FROM posthistory WHERE postid = 3607053 /* 3607053 */ AND /* this works for wiki, for normal posts we need more magic */ /* because we have title and tag records as well */ posthistorytypeid IN (2, 5) /* initial body, edit body */) AS main WHERE text LIKE '%' || 'represents less than 2' || '%'
original:
SELECT  creationdate
     , rev
     , userid as [User Link]
     , comment
     , text
from (
    -- first get all rows for a single post
    -- that reflect an edit
    -- to guarantee the revision nr is correct
    -- as it is dependant on the row_number
    SELECT creationdate
         , row_number() over (order by creationdate asc) as rev
         , userid 
         , comment
         , text
    from posthistory
    where postid = ##postid:int?3607053## -- 3607053
    -- this works for wiki, for normal posts we need more magic
    -- because we have title and tag records as well
    and posthistorytypeid in (2, 5) -- initial body, edit body
) as main
where text like '%' + ##searchfor:String?represents less than 2##  + '%'

       rate.Rate as QuestionsLastMonth,
       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId

;

sql: WITH upvotesbyday AS (SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 DAY' * CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(v.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) AS "day", COUNT(v.id) AS votes FROM votes AS v JOIN posts AS p ON (p.id = v.postid) AND p.posttypeid = 1 WHERE v.votetypeid = 2 GROUP BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 DAY' * CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(v.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT)), downvotesbyday AS (SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 DAY' * CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(v.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) AS "day", COUNT(v.id) AS votes FROM votes AS v JOIN posts AS p ON (p.id = v.postid) AND p.posttypeid = 1 WHERE v.votetypeid = 3 GROUP BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 DAY' * CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(v.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT)) SELECT v."day", v.votes + dv.votes AS "total", v.votes AS "upvotes", dv.votes AS "downvotes" FROM upvotesbyday AS v JOIN downvotesbyday AS dv ON v."day" = dv."day" ORDER BY v."day" NULLS FIRST
original:
WITH  UpVotesByDay  AS (
    SELECT DATEADD (day, DATEDIFF (day, 0, v.CreationDate), 0)  AS [Day],
    COUNT (v.Id) AS Votes

    FROM Votes v 
    JOIN Posts p ON (p.Id = v.PostId) AND p.PostTypeId = 1
    WHERE v.VoteTypeId=2

    GROUP BY DATEADD (day, DATEDIFF (day, 0, v.CreationDate), 0)
),
DownVotesByDay  AS (
    SELECT DATEADD (day, DATEDIFF (day, 0, v.CreationDate), 0)  AS [Day],
    COUNT (v.Id) AS Votes

    FROM Votes v 
    JOIN Posts p ON (p.Id = v.PostId) AND p.PostTypeId = 1
    WHERE v.VoteTypeId=3

    GROUP BY DATEADD (day, DATEDIFF (day, 0, v.CreationDate), 0)
)

SELECT
    v.[Day], 
    v.Votes+dv.Votes AS 'total',
    v.Votes AS 'upvotes',
    dv.Votes AS 'downvotes'

FROM UpVotesByDay v
JOIN DownVotesByDay dv ON v.[Day] = dv.[Day]
ORDER BY v.[Day]

  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  Tags.TagName,
  COUNT(*) AS Questions

FROM Tags
  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

WHERE
  Tags.TagName IN (
    'microservices',
    'soa'
  ) AND

  -- Exclude the current month
  Posts.CreationDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

GROUP BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

ORDER BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

sql: WITH goldbadges AS (SELECT '2010-12-01' || INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(date AS DATE)) AS curdate, COUNT(id) AS badgetotal FROM badges WHERE (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(date AS DATE)) = 2011) AND (class = 1) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(date AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(date AS DATE))), silverbadges AS (SELECT '2010-12-01' || INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(date AS DATE)) AS curdate, COUNT(id) AS badgetotal FROM badges WHERE (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(date AS DATE)) = 2011) AND (class = 2) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(date AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(date AS DATE))), bronzebadges AS (SELECT '2010-12-01' || INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(date AS DATE)) AS curdate, COUNT(id) AS badgetotal FROM badges WHERE (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(date AS DATE)) = 2011) AND (class = 3) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(date AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(date AS DATE))) SELECT goldbadges.curdate, goldbadges.badgetotal AS gold, silverbadges.badgetotal AS silver FROM goldbadges INNER JOIN silverbadges ON goldbadges.curdate = silverbadges.curdate ORDER BY goldbadges.curdate NULLS FIRST
original:
WITH  GoldBadges AS (SELECT DateAdd(m,Month(Date),'2010-12-01') As CurDate, Count(Id) As BadgeTotal
FROM Badges
WHERE (Year(Date) = 2011) And (Class = 1)
GROUP BY Year(Date), Month(Date)),

SilverBadges AS (SELECT DateAdd(m,Month(Date),'2010-12-01') As CurDate, Count(Id) As BadgeTotal
FROM Badges
WHERE (Year(Date) = 2011) And (Class = 2)
GROUP BY Year(Date), Month(Date)),

BronzeBadges AS (SELECT DateAdd(m,Month(Date),'2010-12-01') As CurDate, Count(Id) As BadgeTotal
FROM Badges
WHERE (Year(Date) = 2011) And (Class = 3)
GROUP BY Year(Date), Month(Date))

SELECT GoldBadges.CurDate, GoldBadges.BadgeTotal As Gold, SilverBadges.BadgeTotal As Silver
FROM GoldBadges Inner Join SilverBadges
ON GoldBadges.CurDate = SilverBadges.CurDate
ORDER BY GoldBadges.CurDate;

sql: SELECT post.id AS "post link", posttypes.name AS "type", post.owneruserid AS "user link", post.creationdate, COALESCE(post.viewcount, parent.viewcount) AS "views", COALESCE(post.tags, parent.tags) AS "tags" FROM posts AS post JOIN posttypes ON post.posttypeid = posttypes.id LEFT JOIN posts AS parent ON post.parentid = parent.id LEFT JOIN (posttags JOIN tags ON tags.id = posttags.tagid AND (tagname LIKE '%ajax%' OR tagname LIKE '%coffeescript%' OR tagname LIKE '%css%' OR tagname LIKE '%ecmascript-6%' OR tagname LIKE '%html%' OR tagname LIKE '%javascript%' OR tagname LIKE '%jquery%')) ON posttags.postid IN (post.id, post.parentid) WHERE posttags.postid IS NULL LIMIT 100

SELECT  TOP ##MaxRows:int?100##
  Post.Id AS [Post Link],
  PostTypes.Name AS [Type],
  Post.OwnerUserId AS [User Link],
  Post.CreationDate,
  COALESCE(Post.ViewCount, Parent.ViewCount) AS [Views],
  COALESCE(Post.Tags, Parent.Tags) AS [Tags]
FROM Posts AS Post
  JOIN PostTypes ON Post.PostTypeId = PostTypes.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts AS Parent ON Post.ParentId = Parent.Id
  LEFT JOIN (
    PostTags JOIN Tags ON Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId AND (
      TagName LIKE '%ajax%'
      OR TagName LIKE '%coffeescript%'
      OR TagName LIKE '%css%'
      or TagName LIKE '%ecmascript-6%'
      OR TagName LIKE '%html%'
      OR TagName LIKE '%javascript%'
      OR TagName LIKE '%jquery%'
    )
  ) ON PostTags.PostId IN (Post.Id, Post.ParentId)
WHERE PostTags.PostId IS NULL

sql: SELECT users.id AS "user link", users.reputation AS reputation, COUNT(*) AS "no. answers", SUM(CASE WHEN posts.score < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "no. neg.", CAST(100 * CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN posts.score < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) AS DECIMAL(36, 2)) AS "% negative score", 'http://data.stackexchange.com/physics/query/393837?UserId=' || CAST(users.id AS VARCHAR) || '#graph|Link' AS "answer score distribution" FROM posts INNER JOIN users ON posts.owneruserid = users.id WHERE posttypeid = 2 /* answers */ AND users.reputation >= 1000 GROUP BY users.id, users.reputation HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY '% negative score' DESC NULLS LAST /* ScoreThreshold: Minimum user score */

    CAST( SUM(CASE WHEN Posts.Score<##ScoreThreshold?0## THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT)

INNER JOIN Users ON Posts.OwnerUserId=Users.Id

sql: SELECT "t"."tagname", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUM("p"."score") AS DECIMAL) / CAST(COUNT(1) AS DECIMAL) DESC NULLS LAST) AS "rank", COUNT(1) AS "number", CAST(SUM("p"."score") AS DECIMAL) / CAST(COUNT(1) AS DECIMAL) AS "average score" FROM "posts" AS "p" INNER JOIN "posttags" AS "pt" ON "p"."id" = "pt"."postid" INNER JOIN "tags" AS "t" ON "pt"."tagid" = "t"."id" WHERE "t"."count" > 50 GROUP BY "t"."tagname" ORDER BY CAST(SUM("p"."score") AS DECIMAL) / CAST(COUNT(1) AS DECIMAL) DESC NULLS LAST

  [t].[TagName]
 ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY CONVERT(DECIMAL, SUM([p].[Score])) / CONVERT(DECIMAL, COUNT(1)) DESC) [Rank]
 ,COUNT(1) [Number]
 ,CONVERT(DECIMAL, SUM([p].[Score])) / CONVERT(DECIMAL, COUNT(1)) [Average Score]
FROM
  [Posts] [p]
INNER JOIN
  [PostTags] [pt] ON [p].[Id] = [pt].[PostId]
INNER JOIN
  [Tags] [t] ON [pt].[TagId] = [t].[Id]
WHERE
  [t].[Count] > 50
GROUP BY
  [t].[TagName]
ORDER BY
  CONVERT(DECIMAL, SUM([p].[Score])) / CONVERT(DECIMAL, COUNT(1)) DESC

sql: SELECT CAST(CAST(t.yr AS VARCHAR(4)) || '-' || CAST(t.mnth AS VARCHAR(2)) || '-01' AS DATE) AS dt, (CASE WHEN t.r_mnth_count = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(t.py_mnth_count AS REAL) / CAST(t.r_mnth_count AS REAL) END) AS py_div_r FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)) AS mnth, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)) AS yr /* count <r> tags */, SUM(CASE WHEN tags LIKE '%<r>%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS r_mnth_count /* count <python> tags */, SUM(CASE WHEN tags LIKE '%<python>%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS py_mnth_count FROM posts WHERE tags /* tags are wrapped by <> */ LIKE '%<r>%' OR tags LIKE '%<python>%' GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE))) AS t /* exclude last (incomplete) month */ WHERE NOT (t.mnth = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS DATE)) AND t.yr = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS DATE))) AND yr >= 2014 ORDER BY t.yr ASC NULLS FIRST, t.mnth ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT 
  cast(cast(t.yr as varchar(4))+'-'+cast(t.mnth as varchar(2))+'-01' as date) as dt
  ,(case when t.r_mnth_count=0 then NULL else cast(t.py_mnth_count as float)/cast(t.r_mnth_count as float) end) as py_div_r
from
(
  SELECT
    month(CreationDate) as mnth
    ,year(CreationDate) as yr
    -- count <r> tags
    ,sum(case when tags like '%<r>%' then 1 else 0 end) as r_mnth_count
    -- count <python> tags
    ,sum(case when tags like '%<python>%' then 1 else 0 end) as py_mnth_count
  from
    posts
  where
    -- tags are wrapped by <>
    tags like '%<r>%'
    or tags like '%<python>%'
  group by month(CreationDate), year(CreationDate)
) as t
-- exclude last (incomplete) month
where not (t.mnth=month(GETDATE()) and t.yr=year(GETDATE()))
and yr>=2014
order by t.yr asc, t.mnth asc
