sql: WITH answers AS (SELECT parentid, creationdate FROM posts WHERE posttypeid = 2 /* Answers */ AND score > 0 /* positively voted */), questions AS (SELECT id, creationdate FROM posts WHERE posttypeid = 1 /* Questions */ AND CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) > 100 /* older than XX days */ LIMIT 100) SELECT time_to_answer AS "days until an answer", COUNT(time_to_answer) AS "occurency" FROM (/* question creation dates and time until first answer */ SELECT questions.creationdate, CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(MIN(answers.creationdate) AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(questions.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) AS "time_to_answer" FROM questions LEFT JOIN answers ON questions.id = answers.parentid GROUP BY questions.creationdate LIMIT 100) AS h GROUP BY time_to_answer
original:
WITH  Answers AS (
  SELECT ParentId, CreationDate
    FROM Posts
    WHERE PostTypeId = 2 -- Answers
    AND Score > 0 -- positively voted
),
Questions AS (
  SELECT  TOP 100 Id, CreationDate
    FROM Posts
    WHERE PostTypeId = 1 -- Questions
    AND DATEDIFF(DD, CreationDate, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) > 100 -- older than XX days
)

SELECT TIME_TO_ANSWER AS [Days until an Answer], COUNT(TIME_TO_ANSWER) AS [Occurency]
  FROM (
    -- question creation dates and time until first answer
    SELECT TOP 100 Questions.CreationDate, DATEDIFF(DD, Questions.CreationDate, MIN(Answers.CreationDate)) AS [TIME_TO_ANSWER]
      FROM Questions
      LEFT JOIN Answers
      ON Questions.Id = Answers.ParentId
      GROUP BY Questions.CreationDate
  ) h
  GROUP BY TIME_TO_ANSWER
;

SELECT qId, min(minutes_to_answer) as minutes_to_first_answer from

from

) questions
inner join

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1900) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1) AS month, tags.tagname, COUNT(*) AS questions FROM tags LEFT JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id LEFT JOIN posts ON posts.id = posttags.postid LEFT JOIN posttypes ON posttypes.id = posts.posttypeid WHERE tags.tagname IN ('ios', 'android', 'windows-phone', 'blackberry', 'firefox-os') AND posttypes.name = 'Question' AND posts.creationdate /* Exclude the current month */ < CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), tags.tagname ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, tags.tagname NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  Tags.TagName,
  COUNT(*) AS Questions

FROM Tags
  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

WHERE
  Tags.TagName IN (
    'ios', 'android', 'windows-phone', 'blackberry', 'firefox-os'
  ) AND
  
  PostTypes.Name = 'Question' AND
  
  -- Exclude the current month
  Posts.CreationDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

GROUP BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

ORDER BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

  SELECT ParentId AS Id, MAX(Score) AS Score
  FROM Posts
  WHERE PostTypeId = 2

, Counts AS (
  SELECT
    /* Count for questions joined WITH answers */
    COUNT(*) AS Asked,
    SUM(IIF(Q.AcceptedAnswerId IS NULL, 0, 1)) AS Accepted, 
    SUM(IIF(Q.AcceptedAnswerId IS NULL AND A.Score > 0, 1, 0))
      AS VotedNotAccepted
  FROM Posts Q
  LEFT OUTER JOIN Answers A
    ON Q.Id = A.Id
  WHERE Q.PostTypeId = 1
)
  
SELECT 
  Asked, Accepted, VotedNotAccepted, 
  (Accepted + VotedNotAccepted) AS AcceptedOrVoted, 
  Cast(Cast(
    (Accepted + VotedNotAccepted) / CAST(Asked AS FLOAT)
    *100 as decimal(18,2)) as varchar(5)) + ' %' AS "%AcceptedOrVoted"
FROM Counts

  THEN COALESCE(D.Down, 0)
  ELSE COALESCE(U.Up, 0)
  END Controversity,
  U.Up,
  D.Down,
  U.Up - D.Down AS Score

FROM Posts

LEFT JOIN (

sql: SELECT *, ROUND(CAST(CAST("default" AS DECIMAL) / "total" * 100 AS DECIMAL), 1) AS percentage FROM (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN displayname = N'user' || CAST(id AS VARCHAR) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "default", SUM(CASE WHEN displayname LIKE 'user%' AND NOT displayname = N'user' || CAST(id AS VARCHAR) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "merged?", SUM(CASE WHEN displayname NOT LIKE 'user%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "custom", COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(CAST(LN(reputation) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS "log(reputation)" FROM users GROUP BY ROUND(CAST(LN(reputation) AS DECIMAL), 0)) AS data ORDER BY 5 NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT  *
     , round(cast([default] as decimal)/[total] * 100,1) as percentage
from (
SELECT sum( case 
            when  displayname = N'user' + cast(id as nvarchar) 
            then 1 
            else 0 
            end ) as [default]
     , sum( case 
            when displayname like 'user%' 
                 and not displayname = N'user' + cast(id as nvarchar) 
            then 1 
            else 0 
            end ) as [merged?]
     , sum( case 
            when  displayname not like 'user%' 
            then 1 
            else 
            0 end ) as [custom]
     , count(*) as total
     , round(log(reputation),0) as [log(reputation)]
from users
group by round(log(reputation),0)
) data
order by 5

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) AS creation_month, tagid, COUNT(tagid) AS num_tags FROM posttags INNER JOIN (SELECT postid FROM posttags WHERE tagid = (SELECT id FROM tags WHERE tagname = 'r')) AS p ON posttags.postid = p.postid INNER JOIN (SELECT id, creationdate FROM posts INNER JOIN (SELECT postid FROM posttags WHERE tagid = (SELECT id FROM tags WHERE tagname = 'r')) AS p2 ON posts.id = p2.postid) AS p3 ON posttags.postid = p3.id GROUP BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT), tagid HAVING tagid <> (SELECT id FROM tags WHERE tagname = 'r') AND /* - remove 'r' tags */ CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) >= CAST('2016-01-01' AS DATE) ORDER BY num_tags DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT  DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH,0,creationDate), 0) as creation_month, TagId, count(TagId) as num_tags
from PostTags
inner join (
  SELECT PostId
  from PostTags
  where TagId = (SELECT id from Tags where TagName = 'r')
  ) p
on PostTags.PostId = p.PostId
inner join (
  SELECT Id, creationDate
  from Posts
  inner join (
    SELECT PostId
    from PostTags
    where TagId = (SELECT id from Tags where TagName = 'r')
 ) p2
 on Posts.id = p2.PostId
) p3
on PostTags.PostId = p3.Id
group by DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH,0,creationDate), 0), TagId
having TagId != (SELECT id from Tags where TagName = 'r') and --- remove 'r' tags
DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH,0,creationDate), 0) >= cast('2016-01-01' as Date)
order by num_tags desc

       num.TagName as Tag,
       row_number() over (order by rate.Rate desc) as OctRank,
       row_number() over (order by num.Num desc) as TotalRank,
       rate.Rate as QuestionsInOct,
       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
and Posts.CreationDate < '2016-10-26'
and Posts.CreationDate > '2016-9-26'
group by TagName) as rate

(SELECT count(PostId) as Num, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
group by TagName
having count(PostId) > 1)
as num ON rate.TagName = num.TagName
order by rate.rate desc

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1900) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1) AS month, tags.tagname, COUNT(*) AS questions FROM tags LEFT JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id LEFT JOIN posts ON posts.id = posttags.postid LEFT JOIN posttypes ON posttypes.id = posts.posttypeid WHERE tags.tagname IN ('java', 'python', 'r', 'sas', 'jmp', 'stata', 'spss', 'matlab') AND posttypes.name = 'Question' AND posts.creationdate /* Exclude the current month */ < CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), tags.tagname ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, tags.tagname NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  Tags.TagName,
  COUNT(*) AS Questions

FROM Tags
  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

WHERE
  Tags.TagName IN (
    'java', 'python', 'r', 'sas', 'jmp', 'stata', 'spss', 'matlab'
  ) AND
  
  PostTypes.Name = 'Question' AND
  
  -- Exclude the current month
  Posts.CreationDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

GROUP BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

ORDER BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

sql: WITH useractivitystats AS (SELECT COALESCE(postinfobyuser.userid, commentinfobyuser.userid) AS userid, (SELECT MAX(lastcreationdate) FROM (VALUES (postinfobyuser.lastcreationdate), (commentinfobyuser.lastcreationdate)) AS maxvalues) AS lastactivitydate FROM (SELECT owneruserid AS userid, MAX(creationdate) AS lastcreationdate FROM posts GROUP BY owneruserid) AS postinfobyuser FULL JOIN (SELECT userid, MAX(creationdate) AS lastcreationdate FROM comments GROUP BY userid) AS commentinfobyuser ON postinfobyuser.userid = commentinfobyuser.userid) SELECT userid AS "user link", lastactivitydate FROM useractivitystats ORDER BY lastactivitydate DESC NULLS LAST
original:
WITH  UserActivityStats AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(PostInfoByUser.UserId, CommentInfoByUser.UserId) AS UserId,
    (SELECT Max(LastCreationDate) FROM (VALUES
      (PostInfoByUser.LastCreationDate),
      (CommentInfoByUser.LastCreationDate)
    ) MaxValues) AS LastActivityDate
  FROM (
    SELECT
      OwnerUserId AS UserId,
      Max(CreationDate) AS LastCreationDate
    FROM Posts
    GROUP BY OwnerUserId
  ) PostInfoByUser
  FULL JOIN (
    SELECT
      UserId,
      Max(CreationDate) AS LastCreationDate
    FROM Comments
    GROUP BY UserId
  ) CommentInfoByUser ON PostInfoByUser.UserId = CommentInfoByUser.UserId
)

SELECT
  UserId AS [User Link],
  LastActivityDate
FROM UserActivityStats
ORDER BY LastActivityDate DESC

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1900) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1) AS month, tags.tagname, SUM(posts.viewcount) AS views FROM tags LEFT JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id LEFT JOIN posts ON posts.id = posttags.postid LEFT JOIN posttypes ON posttypes.id = posts.posttypeid WHERE tags.tagname IN ('trello', 'jira') AND posttypes.name = 'Question' AND posts.creationdate /* Exclude the current month */ < CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), tags.tagname ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, tags.tagname NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  Tags.TagName,
  SUM(Posts.ViewCount) AS Views

FROM Tags
  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

WHERE

  Tags.TagName IN (
    'trello', 'jira'
  ) AND
  
  PostTypes.Name = 'Question' AND
  
  -- Exclude the current month
  Posts.CreationDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

GROUP BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

ORDER BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

sql: SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP(caffe.month || '-01 13:37:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "month", caffe.count AS "caffe", tf.count AS "tensorflow" FROM (SELECT CAST(TO_CHAR(creationdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHAR(7)) AS "month", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "stackoverflow".dbo.posts AS p WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.tags LIKE '%<caffe>%' GROUP BY CAST(TO_CHAR(creationdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHAR(7))) AS caffe FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT CAST(TO_CHAR(creationdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHAR(7)) AS "month", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "stackoverflow".dbo.posts AS p WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 AND p.tags LIKE '%<tf>%' GROUP BY CAST(TO_CHAR(creationdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CHAR(7))) AS tf ON tf.month = caffe.month ORDER BY caffe.month ASC NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  convert(datetime, caffe.month + '-01 13:37:00', 120) as [month],
  caffe.count as [Caffe],
  tf.count as [TensorFlow]
from (
  SELECT
    convert(char(7), CreationDate, 20) as [month],
    count(*) as [count]
  from [StackOverflow].dbo.Posts p
  where p.PostTypeId = 1
    and p.Tags like '%<caffe>%' 
  group by convert(char(7), CreationDate, 20)
) as caffe full outer join (
  SELECT
    convert(char(7), CreationDate, 20) as [month],
    count(*) as [count]
  from [StackOverflow].dbo.Posts p
  where p.PostTypeId = 1
    and p.Tags like '%<tf>%' 
  group by convert(char(7), CreationDate, 20)
) as tf on tf.month = caffe.month 
order by caffe.month asc

AS
(
  SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) Rank,

      INNER JOIN PostTags pt ON pt.TagId = t.id

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1900) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1) AS month, tags.tagname, COUNT(*) AS questions FROM tags LEFT JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id LEFT JOIN posts ON posts.id = posttags.postid LEFT JOIN posttypes ON posttypes.id = posts.posttypeid WHERE tags.tagname IN ('angularjs', 'angular2', 'jsf', 'spring-mvc', 'vaadin') AND posttypes.name = 'Question' AND posts.creationdate /* Exclude the current month */ < CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), tags.tagname ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, tags.tagname NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  Tags.TagName,
  COUNT(*) AS Questions

FROM Tags
  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

WHERE
  Tags.TagName IN (
    'angularjs', 'angular2', 'jsf', 'spring-mvc', 'vaadin'
  ) AND
  
  PostTypes.Name = 'Question' AND
  
  -- Exclude the current month
  Posts.CreationDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

GROUP BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

ORDER BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1900) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1) AS month, AVG(CAST(posts.score AS REAL)) AS score FROM posts LEFT JOIN posttypes ON posttypes.id = posts.posttypeid WHERE posttypes.name IN ('Question') GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  AVG(Cast(Posts.score as Float)) AS Score
FROM Posts
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId
WHERE
  PostTypes.Name IN ('Question')
  
GROUP BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate)

ORDER BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate)

sql: SELECT months AS "months since user last seen", posts AS "posts at exactly", SUM(posts) OVER (ORDER BY months DESC NULLS LAST) AS "posts at or before" FROM (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST(users.lastaccessdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST(users.lastaccessdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) AS "months", COUNT(*) AS "posts" FROM users INNER JOIN posts ON posts.owneruserid = users.id GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST(users.lastaccessdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST(users.lastaccessdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT)) AS preliminary ORDER BY months NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  Months AS 'Months since user last seen', 
  Posts AS 'Posts at exactly',
  SUM(Posts) OVER (ORDER BY Months DESC) AS 'Posts at or before'
FROM (
SELECT
  DATEDIFF(mm,Users.LastAccessDate,GETDATE()) AS 'Months',
  COUNT(*) AS 'Posts'
FROM Users
INNER JOIN Posts ON Posts.OwnerUserId = Users.Id
GROUP BY DATEDIFF(mm,Users.LastAccessDate,GETDATE())
--ORDER BY DATEDIFF(mm,Users.LastAccessDate,GETDATE())

) preliminary
ORDER BY Months

sql: WITH endindex AS (SELECT id, parentid AS questionid, body, CASE WHEN POSITION('|' IN SUBSTRING(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(body, ' ', '|'), '<', '|'), ':', '|'), ',', '|') FROM 5)) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE POSITION('|' IN SUBSTRING(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(body, ' ', '|'), '<', '|'), ':', '|'), ',', '|') FROM 5)) + 5 - 1 END AS languagenameendindex FROM posts WHERE posttypeid = 2 /* answer */ AND body LIKE '<h[1-3]>%'), answerlanguages AS (SELECT id, questionid, body, 'http://codegolf.stackexchange.com/a/' || CAST(id AS VARCHAR(99)) AS link, LOWER(SUBSTRING(body FROM 5 FOR languagenameendindex - 5)) AS language FROM endindex) SELECT * FROM answerlanguages WHERE language LIKE '%haskell%'
original:
WITH  EndIndex as (
  select 
      Id, ParentId as QuestionId, Body,
      charindex('|', 
      replace(replace(replace(replace(body, ' ', '|'), '<', '|'), ':', '|'), ',', '|')
        , 5) as LanguageNameEndIndex
  from
      Posts
  where
      PostTypeId = 2 --answer
      and Body like '<h[1-3]>%'
), AnswerLanguages as (
  select 
    Id, QuestionId, Body, 
    'http://codegolf.stackexchange.com/a/' + convert(varchar(99), Id) as Link,
    lower(substring(Body, 5, LanguageNameEndIndex-5)) as Language
  from EndIndex
)
select *
from AnswerLanguages
where Language like '%haskell%'

sql: SELECT u.displayname, SUM(CASE WHEN a.score = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS "scored answers", SUM(CASE WHEN a.score = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "unscored answers", SUM(CASE WHEN a.score = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1000 / COUNT(a.id) / 10.0 AS "percentage unscored" FROM posts AS q INNER JOIN posts AS a JOIN users AS u ON a.owneruserid = u.id ON a.id = q.acceptedanswerid WHERE a.communityowneddate IS NULL AND a.owneruserid <> q.owneruserid AND a.posttypeid = 2 GROUP BY u.displayname HAVING COUNT(a.id) > 10 ORDER BY "percentage unscored" DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT 
     u.DisplayName,
    sum(case when a.Score = 0 then 0 else 1 end) as [Scored Answers],  
    sum(case when a.Score = 0 then 1 else 0 end) as [Unscored Answers],
    sum(CASE WHEN a.Score = 0 then 1 else 0 end)*1000 / count(a.Id) / 10.0 as [Percentage Unscored]
from
    Posts q
  inner join
    Posts a
join
    Users u on a.OwnerUserId = u.Id
  on a.Id = q.AcceptedAnswerId
where
      a.CommunityOwnedDate is null
  and a.OwnerUserId != q.OwnerUserId
  and a.postTypeId = 2
group by  u.DisplayName
having count(a.Id) > 10
order by [Percentage Unscored] desc

sql: SELECT num.tagname AS tag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rate.rate DESC NULLS LAST) AS mayrank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY num.num DESC NULLS LAST) AS totalrank, rate.rate AS questionsinmay, num.num AS questionstotal FROM (SELECT COUNT(postid) AS rate, tagname FROM tags, posttags, posts WHERE tags.id = posttags.tagid AND posts.id = postid AND posts.creationdate > '2016-07-01' GROUP BY tagname) AS rate INNER JOIN (SELECT COUNT(postid) AS num, tagname FROM tags, posttags, posts WHERE tags.id = posttags.tagid AND posts.id = postid GROUP BY tagname HAVING COUNT(postid) > 800) AS num ON rate.tagname = num.tagname ORDER BY rate.rate DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT  
       num.TagName as Tag,
       row_number() over (order by rate.Rate desc) as MayRank,
       row_number() over (order by num.Num desc) as TotalRank,
       rate.Rate as QuestionsInMay,
       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
and Posts.CreationDate > '2016-07-01'
group by TagName) as rate

INNER JOIN

(SELECT count(PostId) as Num, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
group by TagName
having count(PostId) > 800)
as num ON rate.TagName = num.TagName
order by rate.rate desc
;

sql: SELECT tmp.id AS "post link", tmp.upvotes FROM (SELECT p.id, SUM(CASE v.votetypeid WHEN 2 THEN 1 /* Upvote */ ELSE 0 END) AS upvotes, SUM(CASE v.votetypeid WHEN 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downvotes FROM posts AS p JOIN votes AS v ON p.id = v.postid WHERE p.owneruserid = 1 AND p.posttypeid = 2 /* answers */ GROUP BY p.id) AS tmp WHERE tmp.downvotes = 0 ORDER BY tmp.upvotes DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT  tmp.id as [Post Link], tmp.upvotes 

from (

    SELECT P.id 
      , sum(
          case V.voteTypeId 
            when 2 then 1 --Upvote
            else 0 
          end) as Upvotes
      , sum(
          case V.voteTypeId
            when 3 then 1
            else 0
          end) as Downvotes

    from Posts P

    join Votes V
    on P.id = V.postId

  FROM

from (
  SELECT
    OwnerUserId,
    max(case when score > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as up,
    max(case when score < 1 then 1 else 0 end) as down
  from Posts
  where PostTypeId = 1 -- a question

  group by CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), creationDate, 111), OwnerUserId

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) AS mnth, AVG(LENGTH(CAST(a.body AS TEXT))) AS avganswerlength, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN q.tags LIKE '%identify%' THEN LENGTH(CAST(a.body AS TEXT)) ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN q.tags LIKE '%identify%' THEN LENGTH(CAST(a.body AS TEXT)) ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN q.tags LIKE '%identify%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) END AS idavganswerlength FROM posts AS q LEFT OUTER JOIN posts AS a ON q.id = a.parentid AND a.posttypeid = 2 AND a.deletiondate IS NULL WHERE q.posttypeid = 1 AND q.deletiondate IS NULL AND q.closeddate IS NULL GROUP BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) ORDER BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  dateadd(month, datediff(month, 0, q.CreationDate), 0) as Mnth,
  avg(len(a.body)) as AvgAnswerLength,
  case when sum(case when q.Tags like '%identify%' then len(a.body) else 0 end) = 0 then 0
    else sum(case when q.Tags like '%identify%' then len(a.body) else 0 end) * 1.0 / sum(case when q.Tags like '%identify%' then 1 else 0 end)
    end as IDAvgAnswerLength
from posts as q
  left outer join posts as a
    on q.id = a.parentid
      and a.posttypeid = 2
      and a.deletiondate is null
where q.posttypeid = 1
  and q.deletiondate is null
  and q.closeddate is null
group by dateadd(month, datediff(month, 0, q.CreationDate), 0)
order by dateadd(month, datediff(month, 0, q.CreationDate), 0)

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1900) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1) AS month, tags.tagname, COUNT(*) AS questions FROM tags LEFT JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id LEFT JOIN posts ON posts.id = posttags.postid LEFT JOIN posttypes ON posttypes.id = posts.posttypeid WHERE tags.tagname IN ('docker', 'kubernetes', 'mesos', 'docker-swarm', 'coreos', 'lxc', 'openvz', 'runc', 'lxd', 'rocket', 'jail', 'rancher') AND posttypes.name = 'Question' AND posts.creationdate /* Exclude the current month */ < CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), tags.tagname ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, tags.tagname NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  Tags.TagName,
  COUNT(*) AS Questions

FROM Tags
  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

WHERE
  Tags.TagName IN (
    'docker', 'kubernetes', 'mesos', 'docker-swarm', 'coreos', 'lxc', 'openvz', 'runc', 'lxd', 'rocket', 'jail', 'rancher'
  ) AND
  
  PostTypes.Name = 'Question' AND
  
  -- Exclude the current month
  Posts.CreationDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

GROUP BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

ORDER BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

sql: SELECT num.tagname AS tag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rate.rate DESC NULLS LAST) AS nowrank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY num.num DESC NULLS LAST) AS totalrank, rate.rate AS questionsnow, num.num AS questionstotal FROM (SELECT COUNT(postid) AS rate, tagname FROM tags, posttags, posts WHERE tags.id = posttags.tagid AND posts.id = postid AND posts.creationdate < '2017-12-31' AND posts.creationdate > '2017-1-1' GROUP BY tagname) AS rate INNER JOIN (SELECT COUNT(postid) AS num, tagname FROM tags, posttags, posts WHERE tags.id = posttags.tagid AND posts.id = postid GROUP BY tagname HAVING COUNT(postid) > 400) AS num ON rate.tagname = num.tagname ORDER BY rate.rate DESC NULLS LAST

       num.TagName as Tag,
       row_number() over (order by rate.Rate desc) as NowRank,
       row_number() over (order by num.Num desc) as TotalRank,
       rate.Rate as QuestionsNow,
       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
and Posts.CreationDate < '2017-12-31'
and Posts.CreationDate > '2017-1-1'
group by TagName) as rate

INNER JOIN

(SELECT count(PostId) as Num, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
group by TagName
having count(PostId) > 400)
as num ON rate.TagName = num.TagName
order by rate.rate desc
;

  timediff DESC

  dateadd(week, datediff(week, '2000-01-01 00:00:00', sampledate), '2000-01-01 00:00:00') sampleweek,
  max(queuesize) maxqueuesize,
  min(queuesize) minqueuesize
from (
  SELECT
    ref.creationdate sampledate,
    count(*) queuesize
  from
    suggestededits ref
    inner join suggestededits s on (
      s.creationdate <= ref.creationdate and
      (coalesce(s.approvaldate, s.rejectiondate) is null or

  group by
    ref.creationdate

order by
  sampleweek

 FROM Tags

sql: SELECT num.tagname AS tag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rate.rate DESC NULLS LAST) AS mayrank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY num.num DESC NULLS LAST) AS totalrank, rate.rate AS questionsinmay, num.num AS questionstotal FROM (SELECT COUNT(postid) AS rate, tagname FROM tags, posttags, posts WHERE tags.id = posttags.tagid AND posts.id = postid AND posts.creationdate >= '2017-06-01' GROUP BY tagname) AS rate INNER JOIN (SELECT COUNT(postid) AS num, tagname FROM tags, posttags, posts WHERE tags.id = posttags.tagid AND posts.id = postid GROUP BY tagname HAVING COUNT(postid) > 800) AS num ON rate.tagname = num.tagname ORDER BY rate.rate DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT  
       num.TagName as Tag,
       row_number() over (order by rate.Rate desc) as MayRank,
       row_number() over (order by num.Num desc) as TotalRank,
       rate.Rate as QuestionsInMay,
       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
and Posts.CreationDate >= '2017-06-01'
group by TagName) as rate

INNER JOIN

(SELECT count(PostId) as Num, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
group by TagName
having count(PostId) > 800)
as num ON rate.TagName = num.TagName
order by rate.rate desc
;

select a.owneruserid
     , t.tagname

from posts a
inner join posts q on q.id = a.parentid
inner join posttags pt on pt.postid = q.id

( AVG(DATEDIFF(HOUR, p.CreationDate, p.ClosedDate)) ) AS [Time to Close in Hours],
( COUNT(CONVERT(BIGINT,p.Id)) ) AS [Questions Closed]

FROM Posts AS p

GROUP BY

      WHEN p.PostTypeId = 1 THEN 'Q'

   END

count(*) as Count
from Posts p
where

sql: SELECT t.tagname, q.* FROM tags AS t INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(viewcount) AS "total views", SUM(totalscore) AS "total answers score", CAST(SUM(totalscore) * 1000.0 / SUM(viewcount) AS DECIMAL(8, 2)) AS "score per thousand views" FROM posttags AS pt JOIN posts AS pq ON pq.id = pt.postid AND pq.posttypeid = 1 INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(score), 0) AS totalscore FROM posts AS pa WHERE pa.parentid = pq.id) AS q ON TRUE WHERE pt.tagid = t.id) AS q ON TRUE WHERE count >= 490 ORDER BY "score per thousand views" DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT   t.TagName, q.*
FROM    Tags t
CROSS APPLY
        (
        SELECT  SUM(ViewCount) AS [Total Views],
                SUM(TotalScore) AS [Total Answers Score],
                CAST(SUM(TotalScore) * 1000.0 / SUM(ViewCount) AS DECIMAL(8, 2)) AS [Score Per Thousand Views]
        FROM    PostTags pt
        JOIN    Posts pq
        ON      pq.Id = pt.PostId
                AND pq.PostTypeId = 1
        CROSS APPLY
                (
                SELECT  COALESCE(SUM(Score), 0) AS TotalScore
                FROM    Posts pa
                WHERE   pa.ParentId = pq.Id
                ) q
        WHERE   pt.TagID = t.Id
        ) q
WHERE   Count >= 490
ORDER BY
        [Score Per Thousand Views] DESC

sql: SELECT u.id AS u_id, u.displayname AS u_displayname, COUNT(a.id) AS cnt_answers, SUM(a.score) AS sum_score, SUM(p.viewcount) AS sum_views, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(a.id) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank_answers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(a.score) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank_score, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(p.viewcount) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank_views FROM users AS u JOIN posts AS a ON a.owneruserid = u.id JOIN posts AS p ON a.parentid = p.id WHERE a.posttypeid = 2 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(a.creationdate AS DATE)) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS DATE)) AND (p.tags LIKE '%vba%' OR p.tags LIKE '%excel%') GROUP BY u.id, u.displayname ORDER BY COUNT(a.id) DESC NULLS LAST, SUM(a.score) DESC NULLS LAST, SUM(p.viewcount) DESC NULLS LAST

  u.id as u_ID, 
  u.DisplayName as u_DisplayName, 
  count(a.id) as cnt_Answers, 
  sum(a.score) as sum_Score,
  sum(p.viewcount) as sum_Views,
    rank() over   
    (order by count(a.id) desc) AS rank_Answers,
  rank() over   
    (order by sum(a.score) desc) AS rank_Score,
  rank() over   
    (order by sum(p.viewcount) desc) AS rank_Views
  
from users u 
  join posts a on a.owneruserid = u.id
  join posts p on a.parentid = p.id
  
where 
  a.posttypeid = 2 
  and year(a.creationdate) = year(getdate())
  and ( p.tags like '%vba%' or p.tags like '%excel%' )

group by
  u.id, u.DisplayName

order by 
  count(a.id) desc,
  sum(a.score) desc,

sql: SELECT election, 'site://election/' || CAST(election AS VARCHAR) || '?tab=nomination&all=true#post-' || CAST(ep.id AS VARCHAR) || '|' || COALESCE(u.displayname, ownerdisplayname) AS "nomination post" FROM (SELECT DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY max_nom NULLS FIRST) AS election, id FROM (SELECT pm.id, MIN(pm.creationdate) AS min_nom, MAX(pg.creationdate) AS max_nom FROM posts AS pm INNER JOIN posts AS pg ON pg.creationdate BETWEEN pm.creationdate + INTERVAL '-16 DAY' /* roughly 14 days */ AND pm.creationdate + INTERVAL '16 DAY' WHERE pm.posttypeid = 6 AND pg.posttypeid = 6 GROUP BY pm.id) AS data) AS ep INNER JOIN posts AS p ON p.id = ep.id LEFT OUTER JOIN users AS u ON p.owneruserid = u.id ORDER BY election NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT  election
     , 'site://election/' 
     + cast(election as nvarchar)
     + '?tab=nomination&all=true#post-'
     + cast(ep.id as nvarchar)
     + '|'
     + coalesce(u.displayname, ownerdisplayname) as [nomination post]
from
(
  SELECT dense_rank() over(order by max_nom) election
       , id
  from
  (
    SELECT pm.id  
         , min(pm.creationdate) min_nom
         , max(pg.creationdate) max_nom
    from posts pm
    inner join posts pg on pg.creationdate 
          between dateadd(d, -16, pm.creationdate)   -- roughly 14 days
             and dateadd(d, +16, pm.creationdate) 
    where pm.posttypeid = 6
    and   pg.posttypeid = 6
    group by pm.id
  ) data
) ep
inner join posts p on p.id = ep.id
left outer join users u on p.owneruserid =u.id
order by election

WITH 
Questions AS
(
    SELECT Id, CAST(Score AS FLOAT) AS Score
    FROM Posts
    WHERE PostTypeId = 1
),
Answers AS
(
    SELECT ParentId, CAST(Score AS FLOAT) AS Score
    FROM Posts
    WHERE PostTypeId = 2
),
TaggedQuestions AS
(
    SELECT pt.TagId, AVG(q.Score) AS Score
    FROM Questions q
    INNER JOIN PostTags pt ON q.Id = pt.PostId
    GROUP BY pt.TagId
),
TaggedAnswers AS
(
    SELECT pt.TagId, AVG(a.Score) AS Score
    FROM Answers a
    INNER JOIN PostTags pt ON a.ParentId = pt.PostId
    GROUP BY pt.TagId
)
SELECT
    t.TagName,
    q.Score AS QuestionScore,
    a.Score AS AnswerScore
FROM Tags t
FULL OUTER JOIN TaggedQuestions q ON q.TagId = t.Id
FULL OUTER JOIN TaggedAnswers a ON a.TagId = t.Id
WHERE q.Score <= 0
ORDER BY t.Count DESC

sql: SELECT c.userid, u.displayname AS "user name", TO_CHAR(MIN(c.creationdate), 'TMMon FMDD, YYYY') AS "1st comment", TO_CHAR(MAX(c.creationdate), 'TMMon FMDD, YYYY') AS "last comment", COUNT(c.id) AS "# comments", CASE WHEN CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(MAX(c.creationdate) AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(MIN(c.creationdate) AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (CAST(COUNT(c.id) AS DECIMAL) / CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(MAX(c.creationdate) AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(MIN(c.creationdate) AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT)) END AS "comments/day" FROM comments AS c JOIN users AS u ON u.id = c.userid WHERE NOT c.userid IS NULL /* and year(c.creationdate)>=2018 */ GROUP BY c.userid, u.displayname, u.creationdate HAVING CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(MAX(c.creationdate) AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(MIN(c.creationdate) AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) > 0 ORDER BY (COUNT(c.id) / CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(MAX(c.creationdate) AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(MIN(c.creationdate) AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT)) DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT  
  c.userid,
  u.displayname as [User Name],
  format(min(c.creationdate),'MMM d, yyyy') as [1st Comment],
  format(max(c.creationdate),'MMM d, yyyy') as [Last Comment],
  count(c.id) as [# Comments],
  
  case when datediff(d,min(c.creationdate),max(c.creationdate)) = 0
       then null
       else ( cast(count(c.id) as decimal) / datediff(d,min(c.creationdate),max(c.creationdate)) )
       end
    as [Comments/Day]
  
from
  comments c join users u
  on u.id = c.userid
  
  where 
  c.userid is not null
  --and year(c.creationdate)>=2018

group by 
  c.userid ,
  u.displayname,
  u.creationdate

having datediff(d,min(c.creationdate),max(c.creationdate)) > 0

order by
  ( count(c.id) / datediff(d,min(c.creationdate),max(c.creationdate)) ) desc

sql: SELECT num.tagname AS tag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rate.rate DESC NULLS LAST) AS monthrank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY num.num DESC NULLS LAST) AS totalrank, rate.rate AS questionsinmonth, num.num AS questionstotal FROM (SELECT COUNT(postid) AS rate, tagname FROM tags, posttags, posts WHERE tags.id = posttags.tagid AND posts.id = postid AND posts.creationdate < '2018-04-01' AND posts.creationdate > '2018-03-01' GROUP BY tagname) AS rate INNER JOIN (SELECT COUNT(postid) AS num, tagname FROM tags, posttags, posts WHERE tags.id = posttags.tagid AND posts.id = postid GROUP BY tagname HAVING COUNT(postid) > 800) AS num ON rate.tagname = num.tagname ORDER BY rate.rate DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT  
       num.TagName as Tag,
       row_number() over (order by rate.Rate desc) as MonthRank,
       row_number() over (order by num.Num desc) as TotalRank,
       rate.Rate as QuestionsInMonth,
       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
and Posts.CreationDate < '2018-04-01'
and Posts.CreationDate > '2018-03-01'
group by TagName) as rate

INNER JOIN

(SELECT count(PostId) as Num, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
group by TagName
having count(PostId) > 800)
as num ON rate.TagName = num.TagName
order by rate.rate desc
;

sql: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) AS "dayssinceasked", a.id AS "post link", q.viewcount AS "qviews", q.score AS "quescore", q.owneruserid AS "user link", CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(q.lastactivitydate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) AS "dayssinceactive", CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) AS "dayssinceanswered", a.score AS "ansscore" FROM posts AS q JOIN posts AS a ON q.id = a.parentid WHERE q.closeddate IS NULL AND a.closeddate IS NULL AND q.deletiondate IS NULL AND a.deletiondate IS NULL AND q.posttypeid = 1 AND a.posttypeid = 2 AND q.acceptedanswerid IS NULL AND q.answercount = 1 AND a.score > 0 AND a.owneruserid IN (1) ORDER BY a.score + q.score DESC NULLS LAST, q.creationdate DESC NULLS LAST

  datediff(d,q.creationdate,getdate()) as [DaysSinceAsked],
  a.id as [Post Link],
  q.viewcount as [QViews],
  q.score as [QueScore],
  q.owneruserid as [User Link],
  datediff(d,q.lastactivitydate,getdate()) as [DaysSinceActive],
  datediff(d,a.creationdate,getdate()) as [DaysSinceAnswered],
  a.score as [AnsScore]
  
from 
  posts q join posts a
  on q.id = a.parentid

where
  q.closeddate is null and a.closeddate is null
  and q.deletiondate is null and a.deletiondate is null
  and q.posttypeid=1 and a.posttypeid=2
  and q.acceptedanswerid is null
  and q.answercount = 1
  and a.score > 0
  and a.owneruserid in (##UserID##)
  
order by 
  a.score+q.score  desc,
  q.creationdate desc

sql: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY MAX(h.score) DESC NULLS LAST) AS "#", h.owneruserid AS "user link", MAX(h.score) AS hindex FROM (SELECT s.owneruserid, s.score, SUM(s.numanswers) OVER (PARTITION BY s.owneruserid ORDER BY s.score DESC NULLS LAST rows BETWEEN UNBOUNDED preceding AND CURRENT ROW) AS numanswerscumul FROM (SELECT p.owneruserid, p.score, COUNT(*) AS numanswers FROM posts AS p WHERE p.posttypeid = 2 AND p.score >= 4 AND NOT p.owneruserid IS NULL GROUP BY p.owneruserid, p.score) AS s) AS h WHERE h.numanswerscumul >= h.score AND h.score = 4 GROUP BY h.owneruserid ORDER BY "user link" DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT  row_number() over (order by max(H.Score) desc) as [#]
  , H.OwnerUserId as [User Link], max(H.Score) as HIndex
from (
  SELECT S.OwnerUserId, S.Score
    , sum(S.NumAnswers)
      over (partition by S.OwnerUserId order by S.Score desc rows unbounded preceding)
      as NumAnswersCumul
  from (
    SELECT P.OwnerUserId, P.Score, count(*) as NumAnswers
    from Posts P
    where P.PostTypeId = 2
        and P.Score >= 4
        and P.OwnerUserId is not null
    group by P.OwnerUserId, P.Score
    ) S
  ) H
where H.NumAnswersCumul >= H.Score and H.score = 4

      as NumAnswersCumul
  from (

    from Posts P

        and P.OwnerUserId is not null
    group by P.OwnerUserId, L.LinkScore

where H.NumAnswersCumul >= H.LinkScore
group by H.OwnerUserId
order by HIndex desc

  Tags.TagName,
  COUNT(*) AS Questions

  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

    SELECT a, b, '>' FROM accepter_acceptee
    UNION ALL
    SELECT b, a, '<' FROM accepter_acceptee
)

    a,
    b,

  SELECT t.TagName,
       a.OwnerUserId AS [User Link],
       SUM(a.Score) / 10.0 AS Score,
       COUNT(a.Score) AS [Count],
       ((SUM(a.Score) / 10.0) + COUNT(a.Score)) / 2.0 AS Total
  FROM Posts a
  JOIN Posts q on a.ParentId = q.Id
  JOIN PostTags qt ON q.Id = qt.PostId
  JOIN Tags t ON t.Id = qt.TagId
  WHERE a.PostTypeId = 2
    AND a.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL

  GROUP BY a.OwnerUserId, t.TagName

  select TagName, max(Total) as max_score
  from user_tag
  group by TagName
)

  DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, Posts.CreationDate), 0) AS [MONTH],
  CAST(COUNT(
   CASE WHEN (
         Posts.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL
     AND PostHistory.PostHistoryTypeId = 10
     AND PostHistory.Comment IN ('1', '101')
   ) THEN 1 ELSE NULL END
   ) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(
     CASE WHEN PostHistory.PostHistoryTypeId = 1 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END
   ) AS 'DupePercentage'
FROM Posts
LEFT JOIN PostHistory ON Posts.Id = PostHistory.PostId
WHERE Posts.PostTypeId = 1
  AND PostHistory.PostHistoryTypeId IN (1, 10)
GROUP BY DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, Posts.CreationDate), 0)

       num.TagName as Tag,
       row_number() over (order by rate.Rate desc) as JuneRank,
       row_number() over (order by num.Num desc) as TotalRank,
       rate.Rate as QuestionsInJune,
       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
and Posts.CreationDate < '2010-12-31'
and Posts.CreationDate > '2010-01-01'

(SELECT count(PostId) as Num, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
group by TagName
having count(PostId) > 800)
as num ON rate.TagName = num.TagName
order by rate.rate desc
;

sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT downrank + reprank AS rawrank, rankeddowns.userid, rankeddowns.downs, rankeddowns.downrank, reprank.reputation, reprank.reprank FROM (SELECT userid, downs, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY downs DESC NULLS LAST) AS downrank FROM (SELECT posts.owneruserid AS userid, COUNT(*) AS downs FROM votes, posts WHERE votes.postid = posts.id AND votes.votetypeid = 3 GROUP BY posts.owneruserid) AS downs) AS rankeddowns, (SELECT id AS userid, reputation, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY reputation DESC NULLS LAST) AS reprank FROM users) AS reprank WHERE rankeddowns.userid = reprank.userid) AS raw ORDER BY rawrank NULLS FIRST LIMIT 100

FROM (
  SELECT
    DownRank + RepRank AS RawRank,
    RankedDowns.UserId, RankedDowns.Downs, RankedDowns.DownRank,
    RepRank.Reputation, RepRank.RepRank
  FROM (
    SELECT
      UserId,
      Downs,
      DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Downs DESC) AS DownRank
    FROM (
      SELECT Posts.OwnerUserId AS UserId, COUNT(*) AS Downs
      FROM Votes, Posts
      WHERE
        Votes.PostId = Posts.Id
        AND
        Votes.VoteTypeId = 3
      GROUP BY Posts.OwnerUserId
    ) AS Downs
  ) AS RankedDowns,
  (
    SELECT
      Id AS UserId,
      Reputation,
      DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Reputation DESC) AS RepRank
    FROM Users
  ) AS RepRank
  WHERE
    RankedDowns.UserId = RepRank.UserId
) Raw
ORDER BY RawRank

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 WEEK' * CAST(EXTRACT(days FROM (CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) / 7 AS BIGINT) AS m, tagname, COUNT(*) FROM posttags AS pt JOIN posts AS q ON q.id = pt.postid JOIN tags AS t ON t.id = pt.tagid WHERE tagname IN ('serverless', 'containers', 'dockeree') AND q.creationdate < CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 WEEK' * CAST(EXTRACT(days FROM (CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) / 7 AS BIGINT) AND q.creationdate < '2019-01-10' AND q.creationdate > '2018-01-01' GROUP BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 WEEK' * CAST(EXTRACT(days FROM (CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) / 7 AS BIGINT), tagname ORDER BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 WEEK' * CAST(EXTRACT(days FROM (CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) / 7 AS BIGINT) NULLS FIRST
original:

from PostTags pt
join Posts q on q.Id=pt.PostId
join Tags t on t.Id=pt.TagId
where TagName in ('serverless','containers','dockeree')
and q.CreationDate < dateadd(week, datediff(week, 0, getdate()), 0)
and q.CreationDate < '2019-01-10'
and q.CreationDate > '2018-01-01'
group by dateadd(week, datediff(week, 0, q.CreationDate), 0), TagName
order by dateadd(week, datediff(week, 0, q.CreationDate), 0)

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts AS p INNER JOIN (SELECT b1.userid, COUNT(b1.name) AS "badge_count" FROM badges AS b1 INNER JOIN (SELECT COUNT(id) AS "count", name FROM badges WHERE class = 1 AND tagbased = TRUE GROUP BY name HAVING COUNT(id) > 25) AS b2 ON (b1.name = b2.name AND b1.tagbased = TRUE AND b1.class = 1) GROUP BY b1.userid HAVING COUNT(b1.userid) > 5) AS users ON (p.posttypeid = 2 AND p.owneruserid = users.userid)
original:
SELECT  count(*)
FROM Posts as p
INNER JOIN (
        SELECT b1.UserId, count(b1.Name) as 'badge_count' FROM Badges as b1
        INNER JOIN (
              SELECT count(Id) as 'count', Name FROM Badges
              WHERE
                Class=1 AND TagBased = 1
              GROUP BY Name
              Having COUNT(Id) > 25
            ) b2
          ON (
            b1.Name = b2.Name AND
            b1.TagBased = 1 AND
            b1.Class = 1
          )
        GROUP BY b1.UserId
        HAVING count(b1.UserId) > 5
    ) users
    ON (
      p.PostTypeId = 2 AND
      p.OwnerUserId = users.UserId
    )

original:
SELECT  Tags.TagName, 
  LEFT(CONVERT(varchar, Posts.CreationDate,112),6) as month 
  , COUNT(*) as tag_count
FROM
  Posts
  JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.PostId = Posts.Id
  JOIN Tags ON Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId 
WHERE
  Tags.TagName IN (
    'google-cloud-firestore'
    , 'google-cloud-datastore'
    , 'google-cloud-memorystore'
    , 'google-cloud-sql'
    , 'google-cloud-bigtable'
    , 'google-cloud-spanner'
    , 'google-cloud-bigquery'
    , 'amazon-dynamodb'
    , 'amazon-redshift'
    , 'amazon-rds'
    , 'azure-sql-database'
    , 'azure-cosmosdb'
    , 'cloudant'
  )
  AND Posts.CreationDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)
GROUP BY
  Tags.TagName,
  LEFT(CONVERT(varchar, Posts.CreationDate,112),6)
ORDER BY month DESC, tag_count desc

sql: SELECT MIN(t.tagname) AS "tagname", COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(dow FROM creationdate) IN (1, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS weekend, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(dow FROM creationdate) IN (1, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(15, 6)) / COUNT(*) AS ratio FROM posts AS p INNER JOIN posttags AS pt ON p.id = pt.postid INNER JOIN tags AS t ON pt.tagid = t.id WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(p.creationdate AS DATE)) = 2019 GROUP BY t.id ORDER BY total DESC NULLS LAST

        SUM(
            CASE WHEN datepart (dw, CreationDate) IN (1, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS DECIMAL(15, 6)

WITH  FirstBadges as (
    select * from (
        select UserId,
               Name,
               Date,
               Class,
               TagBased,
               row_number() over(partition by UserId, Name, Class order by Date asc) rn
        from Badges
    ) as b 
    where b.rn = 1
)

select row_number() over(order by fb.Date asc) as '#',
       fb.Name as Name,
       fb.Class as Class,

sql: WITH answersbymonth AS (SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) AS mo, COUNT(*) AS answers FROM posts AS a WHERE posttypeid = 2 GROUP BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT)) SELECT mo, CAST(CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST(u.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST(u.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) / 12 AS VARCHAR(8)) AS accountageyears, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / answers AS pctanswers FROM posts AS a JOIN answersbymonth AS abm ON abm.mo = CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) JOIN users AS u ON u.id = a.owneruserid AND u.creationdate < a.creationdate WHERE posttypeid = 2 GROUP BY mo, CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST(u.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST(u.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) / 12, answers ORDER BY mo NULLS FIRST

(
select dateadd(month, datediff(month, 0, a.CreationDate), 0) mo,
  count(*) Answers
from Posts a
where PostTypeId=2
group by dateadd(month, datediff(month, 0, a.CreationDate), 0)
)

select mo,
  cast(datediff(month, u.CreationDate, a.CreationDate)/12 as varchar(8)) AccountAgeYears, 
  count(*)*100.0/Answers PctAnswers
from Posts a

SUM(pp.Score) as Score_Sum,
Count(pp.REP_BUCKET) as Post_Count,

FROM

(SELECT TOP 1000 
p.Score,
case 
   when u.Reputation <= 50 then ' 000 - 50'

   when u.Reputation  > 100 and u.Reputation <= 200 then '101 - 200'
   when u.Reputation  > 200 and u.Reputation <= 300 then '201 - 300'

  SELECT
    MAX(DelHist.Id) AS DelHistId,
    UndelHist.Id AS UndelHistId,
    MAX(UndelHist.PostId) AS PostId,
    MAX(DelHist.CreationDate) AS DeletionDate,
    MAX(UndelHist.CreationDate) AS UndelDate,
    DATEDIFF(second, MAX(DelHist.CreationDate), MAX(UndelHist.CreationDate))
      AS Seconds
  FROM PostHistory DelHist, PostHistory UndelHist
  WHERE
    UndelHist.PostHistoryTypeId = 13
    AND
    DelHist.PostHistoryTypeId = 12
    AND
    DelHist.PostId = UndelHist.PostId
    AND
    DelHist.Id < UndelHist.Id
  GROUP BY
    UndelHist.Id
)

  'site://posts/' + CAST(PostId AS VARCHAR(MAX)) + '/revisions' AS HistoryLink,
  *
FROM Raw
ORDER BY Seconds DESC, PostId

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(v.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(v.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) AS month, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.owneruserid) AS upvotes_per_poster, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.owneruserid) AS downvotes_per_poster, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.owneruserid) AS posts_per_poster FROM votes AS v JOIN posts AS p ON v.postid = p.id WHERE (v.votetypeid = 2 OR v.votetypeid = 3) GROUP BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(v.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(v.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) ORDER BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(v.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(v.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) NULLS FIRST

SELECT  
  dateadd(m, datediff(m,0, v.CreationDate), 0) as month,
  cast(sum(case when v.votetypeid = 2 then 1 else 0 end) as float) / Count(distinct p.OwnerUserId) as upvotes_per_poster,
    cast(sum(case when v.votetypeid = 3 then 1 else 0 end) as float) / Count(distinct p.OwnerUserId) as downvotes_per_poster,
    cast(count(distinct p.id) as float) / Count(distinct p.OwnerUserId) as posts_per_poster

from
  Votes v
  join Posts p
  on v.PostId = p.Id
where
  (v.VoteTypeId = 2
    or
    v.VoteTypeId = 3)
group by dateadd(m, datediff(m,0, v.CreationDate), 0)
order by dateadd(m, datediff(m,0, v.CreationDate), 0)

sql: WITH raw AS (SELECT postid, id AS voteid, SUM(5 - 2 * votetypeid) OVER (PARTITION BY postid ORDER BY id NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS scorenow FROM votes WHERE votetypeid IN (2, 3)), raw2 AS (SELECT postid, voteid, scorenow, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY postid ORDER BY voteid NULLS FIRST) AS n FROM raw WHERE scorenow IN (-1, 1)) SELECT prev.postid AS "post link", 'site:///posts/' || CAST(prev.postid AS VARCHAR(MAX)) || '/timeline|' || CAST(prev.postid AS VARCHAR(MAX)) AS timeline, COUNT(*) AS count FROM raw2 AS prev, raw2 AS next WHERE prev.postid = next.postid AND prev.n + 1 = next.n AND prev.scorenow * next.scorenow = -1 GROUP BY prev.postid ORDER BY count DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100
original:
WITH  Raw AS (
  SELECT PostId, Id AS VoteId, SUM(5-2*VoteTypeId)
    OVER (
      PARTITION BY PostId
      ORDER BY Id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS ScoreNow
  FROM Votes
  WHERE
    VoteTypeId IN (2, 3)
), Raw2 AS (
  SELECT
    PostId, VoteId, ScoreNow,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY PostId ORDER BY VoteId) AS N
  FROM Raw
  WHERE ScoreNow IN (-1, 1)
)
SELECT TOP 100
  Prev.PostId AS [Post Link],
  'site:///posts/' + CAST(Prev.PostId AS VARCHAR(MAX)) + '/timeline|'
    + CAST(Prev.PostId AS VARCHAR(MAX)) AS Timeline,
  COUNT(*) AS Count
FROM Raw2 Prev, Raw2 Next
WHERE
  Prev.PostId = Next.PostId
  AND
  Prev.N + 1 = Next.N
  AND
  Prev.ScoreNow * Next.ScoreNow = -1
GROUP BY Prev.PostId
ORDER BY Count DESC

sql: SELECT '20000109' || INTERVAL '1 WEEK' * (CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST('20000109' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) / 7) AS "week", COUNT(DISTINCT posts.id) AS posts, COUNT(posts.acceptedanswerid) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT posts.id) AS percentwithacceptedanswer, SUM(posts.answercount) AS answers, SUM(posts.commentcount) AS comments FROM posts INNER JOIN posttags ON posttags.postid = posts.id INNER JOIN tags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id WHERE tags.tagname LIKE 'bigcommerce' AND posttypeid = 1 AND creationdate > '2013-01-06' GROUP BY '20000109' || INTERVAL '1 WEEK' * (CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST('20000109' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) / 7) ORDER BY "week" DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT  
  DATEADD(week, DATEDIFF(day, '20000109', CreationDate) / 7, '20000109') AS [WEEK]
  , COUNT(DISTINCT Posts.Id) as Posts, COUNT(Posts.AcceptedAnswerId) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT Posts.Id) as PercentWithAcceptedAnswer, SUM(Posts.AnswerCount) as Answers, SUM(Posts.CommentCount) as Comments
FROM Posts
INNER JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.PostId = Posts.Id
INNER JOIN Tags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
WHERE Tags.TagName like 'bigcommerce' AND PostTypeId = 1 AND CreationDate > '2013-01-06'
GROUP BY  DATEADD(week, DATEDIFF(day, '20000109', CreationDate) / 7, '20000109')
ORDER BY [WEEK] DESC

sql: SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ratio DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank, r.id AS "user link", r.ratio FROM (SELECT u.id, CAST(SUM(a.score) AS REAL) / COUNT(a.score) AS ratio FROM posts AS a INNER JOIN users AS u ON u.id = a.owneruserid WHERE a.posttypeid = 2 AND a.communityowneddate IS NULL GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(a.id) >= 400) AS r ORDER BY r.ratio DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT  rank() over (order by R.Ratio desc) as Rank, R.Id as [User Link], R.Ratio
from (
  SELECT U.Id, cast(sum(A.Score) as real) / count(A.Score) as Ratio
  from Posts A
  inner join Users U on U.Id = A.OwnerUserId
  where A.PostTypeId = 2
    and A.CommunityOwnedDate is null
  group by U.Id
  having count(A.Id) >= ##MinimumAnswerCount?400##
  ) R
order by R.Ratio desc

sql: SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ratio DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank, r.id AS "user link", r.ratio FROM (SELECT u.id, 100 * SUM(0.5 + CAST(a.score AS REAL) * EXP(-CAST(CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) AS REAL) / 365.25)) / COUNT(a.score) AS ratio FROM posts AS a INNER JOIN users AS u ON u.id = a.owneruserid WHERE a.posttypeid = 2 AND a.communityowneddate IS NULL GROUP BY u.id HAVING COUNT(a.id) >= 400) AS r ORDER BY r.ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1000

  rank() over (order by R.Ratio desc) as Rank, R.Id as [User Link], R.Ratio
from (
SELECT U.Id, 100 * sum(0.5 + cast(A.Score as real) * exp(-cast(datediff(day, A.CreationDate, getdate() ) as real) / 365.25)) / count(A.Score) as Ratio
  from Posts A
  inner join Users U on U.Id = A.OwnerUserId
  where A.PostTypeId = 2
    and A.CommunityOwnedDate is null
  group by U.Id
  having count(A.Id) >= ##MinimumAnswerCount?400##
  ) R

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1900) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1) AS month, tags.tagname, SUM(posts.viewcount) AS views FROM tags LEFT JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id LEFT JOIN posts ON posts.id = posttags.postid LEFT JOIN posttypes ON posttypes.id = posts.posttypeid WHERE tags.tagname IN ('ruby') AND posttypes.name = 'Question' AND posts.creationdate /* Exclude the current month */ < CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), tags.tagname ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, tags.tagname NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  Tags.TagName,
  SUM(Posts.ViewCount) AS Views

FROM Tags
  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

WHERE

  Tags.TagName IN (
    'ruby'
  ) AND
  
  PostTypes.Name = 'Question' AND
  
  -- Exclude the current month
  Posts.CreationDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

GROUP BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

ORDER BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

sql: WITH queststatsbymonth AS (SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) AS "month", SUM(q.score) AS totalscore, COUNT(q.id) AS numquests FROM posts AS q WHERE q.posttypeid = 1 GROUP BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT)) SELECT q."month", CAST(SUM(h.totalscore) AS REAL) / CAST(SUM(h.numquests) AS REAL) AS "average score", SUM(h.numquests) AS "number of posts" FROM queststatsbymonth AS q LEFT JOIN queststatsbymonth AS h ON h."month" = q."month" GROUP BY q."month" ORDER BY q."month" NULLS FIRST
original:
WITH  QuestStatsByMonth  AS (
    SELECT      DATEADD (month, DATEDIFF (month, 0, q.CreationDate), 0)  AS [Month],
    SUM (q.Score)               AS TotalScore,
    COUNT (q.Id)                AS NumQuests

    FROM        Posts           q
    WHERE       q.PostTypeId    = 1

    GROUP BY    DATEADD (month, DATEDIFF (month, 0, q.CreationDate), 0)
)
SELECT
    q.[Month],
    CAST(SUM (h.TotalScore) AS float) / CAST(SUM (h.NumQuests) AS float) as [Average score],
    SUM (h.NumQuests) as [Number of posts]

FROM        QuestStatsByMonth   q
LEFT JOIN   QuestStatsByMonth   h
ON          h.[Month]           = q.[Month]
GROUP BY    q.[Month]
ORDER BY    q.[Month]

sql: WITH raw AS (SELECT id, posttypeid, CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(LAG(creationdate) OVER (PARTITION BY owneruserid, posttypeid ORDER BY creationdate DESC NULLS LAST) AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) AS daytonext, CASE WHEN NOT closeddate IS NULL OR score < 0 THEN -1 WHEN score > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS sign FROM posts WHERE posttypeid <= 2 AND owneruserid > 0) SELECT daytonext, CASE WHEN sign = 1 THEN 'Positive' WHEN sign = -1 THEN 'Negative' ELSE 'Neutral' END || ' ' || CASE WHEN posttypeid = 1 THEN 'Question' ELSE 'Answer' END AS posttype, LN(COUNT(*)) / LN(10) AS logcount FROM raw WHERE daytonext >= 0 GROUP BY posttypeid, daytonext, sign ORDER BY posttype NULLS FIRST, daytonext NULLS FIRST
original:
WITH  Raw AS (
  SELECT
    Id,
    PostTypeId,
    DATEDIFF(day, CreationDate, LAG(CreationDate) OVER (
      PARTITION BY OwnerUserId, PostTypeId ORDER BY CreationDate DESC)
    ) AS DayToNext,
    CASE
      WHEN ClosedDate IS NOT NULL OR Score < 0 THEN -1
      WHEN Score > 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS Sign
  FROM Posts
  WHERE
    PostTypeId <= 2
    AND
    OwnerUserId > 0
)
SELECT
  DayToNext,
  CASE
    WHEN Sign = 1 THEN 'Positive'
    WHEN Sign = -1 THEN 'Negative'
    ELSE 'Neutral'
  END + ' ' +
  CASE WHEN PostTypeId = 1 THEN 'Question' ELSE 'Answer' END AS PostType,
  LOG(COUNT(*))/LOG(10) AS LogCount
FROM Raw
WHERE DayToNext >= 0
GROUP BY PostTypeId, DayToNext, Sign
ORDER BY PostType, DayToNext

  Tags.TagName,
  COUNT(*) AS Questions

  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

          SUM(CASE WHEN a.parentid IS NULL THEN 1 END)
                                        AS [Open Unanswered Questions],
          COUNT(a.parentid)             AS [Questions with Answers],
          
          COUNT(CASE WHEN a.score > 0 THEN a.parentid END)
                                        AS [Qs with Positive Answers]
      
FROM      posts q

   SELECT DISTINCT ans.parentid,
                   MAX(ans.score) AS [score]
   FROM posts ans
   WHERE ans.posttypeid = 2

) a

sql: SELECT sel.idx - (sel.idx / 1) * 1 AS "answer score", sel.idx / 1 AS "comment score", COUNT(sel.idx) AS "occurence" FROM (SELECT sel.ascore * 1 + sel.cscore AS "idx" FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN a.score < 1 THEN a.score ELSE 1 END AS "ascore", CASE WHEN c.score < 1 THEN c.score ELSE 1 END AS "cscore" FROM posts AS a INNER JOIN (SELECT c.postid, MAX(c.score) AS "score" /* PostId and highest voted comment score */ FROM comments AS c WHERE c.score > 0 GROUP BY c.postid) AS c ON a.id = c.postid WHERE a.posttypeid = 2 /* answers */ AND a.score >= 0) AS sel) AS sel GROUP BY sel.idx ORDER BY sel.idx NULLS FIRST

FROM 
(SELECT sel.AScore * ##N## + sel.CScore as [Idx]
FROM
(SELECT IIF(a.Score < ##N##, a.Score, ##N##) as [AScore], IIF(c.Score < ##N##, c.Score, ##N##) as [CScore]
FROM Posts a
INNER JOIN
( SELECT c.PostId, MAX(c.Score) as [Score] -- PostId and highest voted comment score
  FROM Comments c
  WHERE c.Score > 0
  GROUP BY c.PostId) c
ON a.Id = c.PostId
WHERE a.PostTypeId = 2 -- answers
AND a.Score >= 0) sel) sel
GROUP BY sel.Idx
ORDER BY sel.Idx

sql: SELECT gvt.zmonth AS "month", (gvt.upvt * 1.0 / gvt.dwnvt) * (1750000 / 25) AS "up/down vote ratio, on posts (q+a) -scaled", gvt.upvt AS "upvote %", gvt.dwnvt AS "downvote %" FROM (SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(v.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(v.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) AS zmonth, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS upvt, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dwnvt FROM votes AS v GROUP BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(v.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(v.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT)) AS gvt WHERE gvt.dwnvt <> 0 ORDER BY gvt.zmonth NULLS FIRST

, (gVt.upVt * 1.0 / gVt.dwnVt)*(1750000/25)         AS [Up/Down Vote ratio, on Posts (Q+A) -Scaled]
        , gVt.upVt                                  AS [Upvote %]
        , gVt.dwnVt                                 AS [Downvote %]   
FROM        (
    SELECT      zMonth  = DATEADD (month, DATEDIFF (month, 0, v.CreationDate), 0)
                , upVt  = SUM (CASE  WHEN v.VoteTypeId = 2  THEN 1  ELSE 0  END)
                , dwnVt = SUM (CASE  WHEN v.VoteTypeId = 3  THEN 1  ELSE 0  END)
    FROM        Votes v
    GROUP BY    DATEADD (month, DATEDIFF (month, 0, v.CreationDate), 0)
) gVt
WHERE       gVt.dwnVt != 0
ORDER BY    gVt.zMonth

  (SELECT DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, MIN(CreationDate)), 0) AS YearMon,
          LOG(COUNT(*), 10) AS Num
   FROM Posts

   GROUP BY YEAR(CreationDate),
            MONTH(CreationDate)),

  (SELECT DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, MIN(Posts.CreationDate)), 0) AS YearMon,

   FROM Posts
   INNER JOIN PostHistory ON PostHistory.PostId = Posts.Id
   WHERE PostHistory.Comment IN ('1',
                                 '101')
   GROUP BY YEAR(Posts.CreationDate),
            MONTH(Posts.CreationDate))

       AllQ.Num AS Total_log10,
       Dupes.Num AS Dupes_log10

  (

      t.TagName,

      t.Count as Total,

      ((CAST(t.Count as float) / CAST(18389372 as float))*100) as [% of Site]
      FROM Posts p
      INNER JOIN PostTags pt ON p.Id = pt.PostId
      INNER JOIN Tags t ON pt.TagId = t.Id

sql: WITH a AS (SELECT id, reviewtasktypeid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creationdate) + 1.00 * FLOOR((EXTRACT(MONTH FROM creationdate) - 1.00) / 3) / 4 AS "month", CASE WHEN CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(deletiondate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) = 0 THEN 'same day' WHEN CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(deletiondate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) = 1 THEN 'next day' WHEN CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(deletiondate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) > 1 THEN 'longer' END AS "duration" FROM reviewtasks WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creationdate) + 1.00 * FLOOR((EXTRACT(MONTH FROM creationdate) - 1.00) / 3) / 4 < EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02') + 1.00 * FLOOR((EXTRACT(MONTH FROM TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02') - 1.00) / 3) / 4 AND reviewtasktypeid IN (2, 6)) SELECT "month", "duration", COUNT(id) FROM a GROUP BY "month", "duration" ORDER BY "month" NULLS FIRST
original:
WITH  a as (Select 
     Id,
     ReviewTaskTypeId,
     DATEPART(YYYY, CreationDate) +
     1.00*FLOOR((DATEPART(MM,   CreationDate)-1.00)/3)/4  as [Month], 
     case when DATEDIFF(dd, CreationDate, DeletionDate)=0 
             then 'same day'
          when DATEDIFF(dd, CreationDate, DeletionDate)=1 
             then 'next day'
          when DATEDIFF(dd, CreationDate, DeletionDate)>1 
             then 'longer'
     end as [Duration]
from ReviewTasks
where   DATEPART(YYYY, CreationDate) +
        1.00*FLOOR((DATEPART(MM,   CreationDate)-1.00)/3)/4 <
        DATEPART(YYYY, GETDATE()) +
        1.00*FLOOR((DATEPART(MM,   GETDATE())-1.00)/3)/4
        and  ReviewTaskTypeId in (2,6)
)

from a
group by [Month], [Duration]
order by [Month]

WITH  Raw AS (
  SELECT
    Id,
    DATEADD(
      day,
      7*(DATEDIFF(day, '1970-01-05', CreationDate)/7),
      '1970-01-05'
    ) AS Week,
    OwnerUserId AS UserId
  FROM Posts
  WHERE
    PostTypeId = 2
    AND
    OwnerUserId > 0
), Raw2 AS (
  SELECT
    Week,
    UserId,
    COUNT(*) AS PostCount
  FROM Raw
  GROUP BY Week, UserId
)
SELECT
  Week,
  COUNT(*) AS UserCount
FROM Raw2
WHERE PostCount > 3
GROUP BY Week
ORDER BY Week

sql: SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(CASE pf.votetypeid WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 3 THEN -1 END) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank, p.owneruserid AS "user link", p.ownerdisplayname, SUM(CASE WHEN pf.votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS upfeedback, SUM(CASE WHEN pf.votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS downfeedback, SUM(CASE pf.votetypeid WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 3 THEN -1 END) AS score, SUM(p.score) AS "total score", SUM(CASE WHEN p.communityowneddate IS NULL THEN p.score ELSE 0 END) AS "noncw score" FROM postfeedback AS pf JOIN posts AS p ON p.id = pf.postid GROUP BY p.owneruserid, p.ownerdisplayname ORDER BY SUM(CASE pf.votetypeid WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 3 THEN -1 END) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100

  RANK() OVER(ORDER BY SUM(Case pf.VoteTypeId When 2 Then 1 WHEN 3 Then -1 End) DESC) AS Rank,
  p.OwnerUserId as [User Link], p.OwnerDisplayName,
  SUM(Case When pf.VoteTypeId = 2 Then 1 Else NULL End) AS UpFeedback,
  SUM(Case When pf.VoteTypeId = 3 Then 1 Else NULL End) AS DownFeedback,
  SUM(Case pf.VoteTypeId When 2 Then 1 WHEN 3 Then -1 End) AS Score,

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) AS month, COUNT(CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT)) AS "monthly joins" FROM users GROUP BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) ORDER BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  DateAdd(month, DateDiff(month, 0, CreationDate), 0) As Month,
  Count(DateAdd(month, DateDiff(month, 0, CreationDate),0)) As 'Monthly Joins'
FROM
  Users
GROUP BY
  DateAdd(month, DateDiff(month, 0, CreationDate), 0)
ORDER BY
  DateAdd(month, DateDiff(month, 0, CreationDate), 0);

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(posts.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(posts.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) AS month, tags.tagname, COUNT(posts.id) AS questions FROM posts LEFT JOIN posttags ON posts.id = posttags.postid LEFT JOIN tags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id WHERE posts.posttypeid = 1 AND (posttags.tagid = 4452 OR posttags.tagid = 16) GROUP BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(posts.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(posts.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT), tags.tagname ORDER BY CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(posts.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(posts.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) DESC NULLS LAST, tags.tagname NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
    DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, Posts.creationDate), 0) AS Month,
    Tags.TagName,
    Count(Posts.Id) AS Questions
FROM Posts
    LEFT JOIN PostTags ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
    LEFT JOIN Tags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
WHERE 
    Posts.PostTypeId = 1 and
    (PostTags.TagId = 4452 or PostTags.TagId = 16)
GROUP BY
    DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, Posts.creationDate), 0), Tags.TagName
ORDER BY 
    DATEADD(MONTH, DATEDIFF(MONTH, 0, Posts.creationDate), 0) DESC, Tags.TagName

sql: SELECT ((CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(p.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST('2020-06-15' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT)) / 7) + 1 AS weekno, '2020-06-15' || INTERVAL '1 DAY' * (CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(p.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST('2020-06-15' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) / 7) * 7 AS weekstarting, COUNT(p.id) AS questionsasked, COUNT(CASE WHEN score > 0 THEN 1 END) AS positivescore, COUNT(CASE WHEN score = 0 THEN 1 END) AS neutralscore, COUNT(CASE WHEN score < 0 THEN 1 END) AS negativescore, COUNT(closeddate) AS closed FROM dbo.posts AS p JOIN dbo.posttypes AS pt ON p.posttypeid = pt.id WHERE p.creationdate >= '2020-06-15' AND p.creationdate < '2020-06-15' AND pt."name" = 'Question' GROUP BY ((CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(p.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST('20181202' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT)) / 7) ORDER BY ((CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(p.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST('20181202' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT)) / 7) NULLS FIRST
