       DATEADD(DAY,((DATEDIFF(DAY,##StartDate:string##,P.CreationDate)) / 7)*7,##StartDate:string##) AS WeekStarting,
       COUNT(P.Id) AS QuestionsAsked,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN Score > 0 THEN 1 END) AS PositiveScore,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN Score = 0 THEN 1 END) AS NeutralScore,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN Score < 0 THEN 1 END) AS NegativeScore,
       COUNT(ClosedDate) AS Closed
FROM dbo.Posts P
     JOIN dbo.PostTypes PT ON P.PostTypeId = PT.Id
WHERE P.CreationDate >= ##StartDate:string##
  AND P.CreationDate < ##EndDate:string##
  AND PT.[Name] = 'Question'
GROUP BY ((DATEDIFF(DAY,'20181202',P.CreationDate)) / 7)
ORDER BY ((DATEDIFF(DAY,'20181202',P.CreationDate)) / 7);

sql: WITH raw AS (SELECT q.id AS qid, q.owneruserid AS quserid, a.id AS aid, a.owneruserid AS auserid FROM posts AS q, posts AS a WHERE a.parentid = q.id AND q.owneruserid = a.owneruserid AND q.owneruserid > 0 AND q.communityowneddate IS NULL AND a.communityowneddate IS NULL), raw2 AS (SELECT DISTINCT qid AS id, quserid AS userid FROM raw UNION ALL SELECT aid AS id, auserid AS userid FROM raw) SELECT raw2.userid AS "user link", SUM(CASE WHEN votes.votetypeid = 2 THEN 10 ELSE -2 END) AS rep FROM raw2, votes WHERE raw2.id = votes.postid AND votes.votetypeid BETWEEN 2 AND 3 GROUP BY raw2.userid ORDER BY rep DESC NULLS LAST, raw2.userid NULLS FIRST LIMIT 100

WITH  Raw AS (
  SELECT
    Q.Id AS QId, 
    Q.OwnerUserId AS QUserId,
    A.Id AS AId,
    A.OwnerUserId AS AUserId
  FROM Posts Q, Posts A
  WHERE
    A.ParentId = Q.Id
    AND
    Q.OwnerUserId = A.OwnerUserId
    AND
    Q.OwnerUserId > 0
    AND
    Q.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL
    AND
    A.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL
),
Raw2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    QId AS Id,
    QUserId AS UserId
  FROM Raw

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    AId AS Id,
    AUserId AS UserId
  FROM Raw
)
SELECT TOP 100
  Raw2.UserId AS [User Link],
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN Votes.VoteTypeId = 2 THEN 10
    ELSE -2
  END) AS Rep
FROM Raw2, Votes
WHERE
  Raw2.Id = Votes.PostId
  AND
  Votes.VoteTypeId BETWEEN 2 AND 3
GROUP BY Raw2.UserId
ORDER BY Rep DESC, Raw2.UserId

    t.TagName as tag,
    count(p.id) as total
  from
    Posts p
    inner join PostTags pt on p.Id = pt.PostId
    inner join Tags t on t.Id = pt.TagId

    p.CreationDate > '2018-01-01' AND
    (

      t.TagName = 'unity'

) q

  FROM Posts p
  INNER JOIN Users ou ON p.OwnerUserId = ou.Id),
EditorDates AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(p.CreationDate AS DATE) AS [Date], eu.Id, eu.Reputation
  FROM Posts p
  LEFT JOIN Users eu ON p.LastEditorUserId = eu.Id),
UserDates AS (SELECT * FROM CreatorDates INTERSECT SELECT * FROM EditorDates),
Results AS (SELECT 
COUNT(DISTINCT IIF([Date] >= DATEADD(MONTH, -6, GETDATE()), Id, NULL)) As recent,
  COUNT(DISTINCT IIF([Date] >= DATEADD(MONTH, -60, GETDATE()) AND [Date] <= DATEADD(MONTH, -54, GETDATE()), Id, NULL)) As five,
  POWER(10,FLOOR(LOG10(Reputation))) As bucket
FROM UserDates
GROUP BY FLOOR(LOG10(Reputation)))
SELECT *, five - recent as diff FROM Results

  SELECT t.TagName,
       a.OwnerUserId AS [User Link],

  WHERE a.PostTypeId = 2

  GROUP BY a.OwnerUserId, t.TagName

       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
-- and Posts.CreationDate < '2010-06-01'

order by rate.rate desc
;

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) AS "month", COUNT(q.id) AS numquests FROM posts AS q INNER JOIN posttags AS pt ON q.id = pt.postid INNER JOIN tags AS t ON t.id = pt.tagid WHERE q.posttypeid = 1 AND q.creationdate >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT), t.tagname ORDER BY numquests DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT       DATEADD (month, DATEDIFF (month, 0, q.CreationDate), 0)  AS [Month],
    
    COUNT (q.Id)                AS NumQuests

    FROM        Posts           q
    INNER JOIN  PostTags        pt
    ON          q.Id            = pt.PostId
    INNER JOIN  Tags            t
    ON          t.Id            = pt.TagId

    WHERE       q.PostTypeId    = 1
    AND         q.CreationDate >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00'

    GROUP BY    DATEDIFF (month, 0, q.CreationDate), 
                t.TagName
    order by    NumQuests Desc

  DATENAME(month, CreationDate) AS month,
  DATEPART(month, CreationDate) AS month_part,
  COUNT(*) AS post_count,

  --COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*))  AS post_percent

  Sum( case when P.PostTypeId = 2 then 1 else 0 end ) as Answers
  from Users as U inner join
    Posts as P on P.OwnerUserId = U.Id and P.PostTypeId in ( 1, 2 )
  -- A reputation of at least 25000.
  where U.Reputation >= 25000
  group by U.Id, U.DisplayName, U.Reputation
  having
    -- Asked at least 200 questions and ...
    Sum( case when P.PostTypeId = 1 then 1 else 0 end ) >= 200 and
    -- ... contributed no more than 5 answers.
    Sum( case when P.PostTypeId = 2 then 1 else 0 end ) <= 5
  order by U.Reputation desc

       pu.TotalCount,
       pu.PopularCount,
       pu.PopularCount*1.0/pu.TotalCount AS PopularRatio
FROM
  (SELECT p.OwnerUserId,
          count(1) AS TotalCount,
          sum(CASE
                  WHEN p.ViewCount>=1000 THEN 1
                  ELSE 0

   FROM Posts p

   HAVING count(1) >= 10) pu
WHERE pu.PopularCount>0
ORDER BY PopularRatio DESC

  from Comments
  group by DateAdd(month, DateDiff(month, 0, CreationDate), 0)

  SELECT
    YEAR(Votes.CreationDate) AS Year,
    Posts.OwnerUserId AS UserId,
    COUNT(*) AS Count

),

),

  SELECT DISTINCT UserId
  FROM Raw2
  WHERE Rank <= ##TopN:int?5##
)

sql: SELECT t.tagname, COUNT(*) AS nrofquestions, AVG(repgain) AS avgrepgain FROM tags AS t JOIN posttags AS pt ON pt.tagid = t.id JOIN (SELECT pp.id, SUM(CASE WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN 10 WHEN v.votetypeid = 2 THEN -2 ELSE NULL END) AS repgain FROM posts AS pp JOIN posts AS pa ON pa.parentid = pp.id JOIN votes AS v ON v.postid = pa.id GROUP BY pp.id) AS pv ON pv.id = pt.postid GROUP BY t.tagname HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ORDER BY AVG(repgain) DESC NULLS LAST

,       COUNT(*) as NrOfQuestions 
,       AVG(RepGain) as AvgRepGain

JOIN    (
        SELECT  pp.id
        ,       SUM(case when v.votetypeid = 2 then 10
                         when v.votetypeid = 2 then -2
                         else null 
                    end) As RepGain
        FROM    posts pp
        JOIN    posts pa
        ON      pa.parentid = pp.id
        JOIN    votes v
        ON      v.postid = pa.id
        GROUP BY
                pp.id
        ) as pv

        t.tagName
HAVING
        COUNT(*) > 1000
ORDER BY
        AVG(RepGain) DESC

sql: SELECT tot.rep, tot.totalanswers, acc.acceptedanswers, (1.0 * acc.acceptedanswers / tot.totalanswers) FROM (SELECT users.reputation / 100 AS rep, COUNT(users.id) AS totalanswers FROM posts JOIN users ON posts.owneruserid = users.id WHERE posts.posttypeid = 2 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) = 2013 GROUP BY users.reputation / 100) AS tot JOIN (SELECT users.reputation / 100 AS rep, COUNT(users.id) AS acceptedanswers FROM posts AS a JOIN posts AS b ON a.acceptedanswerid = b.id AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(b.creationdate AS DATE)) = 2013 JOIN users ON users.id = b.owneruserid GROUP BY users.reputation / 100) AS acc ON tot.rep = acc.rep ORDER BY 1 NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT  Tot.Rep, Tot.TotalAnswers, Acc.AcceptedAnswers, (1.0 * Acc.AcceptedAnswers / Tot.TotalAnswers)
FROM 
(SELECT Users.Reputation / 100 as Rep, COUNT(Users.Id) as TotalAnswers
FROM Posts JOIN Users 
     ON Posts.OwnerUserId = Users.Id
WHERE Posts.PostTypeId = 2 AND YEAR(Posts.CreationDate) = 2013
GROUP BY Users.Reputation / 100) as Tot
JOIN
(SELECT Users.Reputation / 100 as Rep, COUNT(Users.Id) as AcceptedAnswers
FROM Posts as A 
     JOIN 
     Posts as B
     on A.AcceptedAnswerId = B.Id AND YEAR(B.CreationDate) = 2013
     JOIN 
     Users 
     on Users.Id = B.OwnerUserId 
     GROUP BY Users.Reputation / 100) as Acc
On Tot.Rep = Acc.Rep
ORDER BY 1

sql: SELECT (acc.cyear - 2011) * 12 + acc.cmonth AS monthy, (1.0 * acc.accanswers / tot.totanswers) AS percentage FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(users.creationdate AS DATE)) AS cyear, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(users.creationdate AS DATE)) AS cmonth, COUNT(users.id) AS accanswers FROM posts AS a JOIN posts AS b ON a.acceptedanswerid = b.id JOIN users ON users.id = b.owneruserid GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(users.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(users.creationdate AS DATE))) AS acc JOIN (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(users.creationdate AS DATE)) AS cyear, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(users.creationdate AS DATE)) AS cmonth, COUNT(users.id) AS totanswers FROM posts AS a JOIN users ON users.id = a.owneruserid WHERE a.posttypeid = 2 GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(users.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(users.creationdate AS DATE))) AS tot ON acc.cyear = tot.cyear AND acc.cmonth = tot.cmonth ORDER BY 1 NULLS FIRST, 2 NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT  (ACC.cYear - 2011) * 12 +  ACC.cMonth as Monthy, (1.0 * ACC.AccAnswers / TOT.TotAnswers) as Percentage
FROM
(SELECT YEAR(Users.CreationDate) as cYear, Month(Users.CreationDate) cMonth, COUNT(Users.Id) as AccAnswers
FROM Posts as A 
     JOIN 
     Posts as B
     on A.AcceptedAnswerId = B.Id 
     JOIN 
     Users 
     on Users.Id = B.OwnerUserId 
     GROUP BY YEAR(Users.CreationDate), Month(Users.CreationDate)) AS ACC
JOIN 
(SELECT YEAR(Users.CreationDate) as cYear, Month(Users.CreationDate) cMonth, COUNT(Users.Id) as TotAnswers
FROM Posts as A 
     JOIN 
     Users 
     on Users.Id = A.OwnerUserId 
     WHERE A.PostTypeId = 2
     GROUP BY YEAR(Users.CreationDate), Month(Users.CreationDate)) AS TOT
ON ACC.cYear = TOT.cYear AND ACC.cMonth = TOT.cMonth
ORDER BY 1,2

sql: SELECT AVG(LENGTH(CAST(a.body AS TEXT))) AS averagelength, AVG(a.score) AS answerscore, AVG(a.score) + STDDEV(a.score) AS plusonesigma, AVG(a.score) - STDDEV(a.score) AS minusonesigma FROM posts AS a INNER JOIN posts AS q ON a.parentid = q.id WHERE a.posttypeid = 2 AND LENGTH(CAST(a.body AS TEXT)) <= 20000 AND a.id = q.acceptedanswerid GROUP BY ROUND(LENGTH(CAST(a.body AS TEXT)), -3) ORDER BY ROUND(LENGTH(CAST(a.body AS TEXT)), -3) NULLS FIRST

SELECT  AVG(LEN(A.Body)) as AverageLength,
       AVG(A.Score) AS AnswerScore,
       AVG(A.Score) + STDEV(A.Score) AS PlusOneSigma,
       AVG(A.Score) - STDEV(A.Score) AS MinusOneSigma
FROM Posts A INNER JOIN Posts Q ON A.ParentID = Q.Id
WHERE A.PostTypeId = 2 AND
      LEN(A.Body) <= 20000 AND
      A.Id = Q.AcceptedAnswerID
GROUP BY ROUND(LEN(A.Body), -3) ORDER BY ROUND(LEN(A.Body), -3)

sql: SELECT AVG(q.score) AS questionscore, AVG(a.score) AS answerscore, AVG(a.score) + STDDEV(a.score) AS plusonesigma, AVG(a.score) - STDDEV(a.score) AS minusonesigma FROM posts AS a INNER JOIN posts AS q ON a.parentid = q.id WHERE a.posttypeid = 2 AND q.score <= 100 GROUP BY SIGN(q.score) * ROUND(CAST(SQRT(ABS(q.score) * 10) AS DECIMAL), 0) ORDER BY SIGN(q.score) * ROUND(CAST(SQRT(ABS(q.score) * 10) AS DECIMAL), 0) NULLS FIRST

       AVG(A.Score) AS AnswerScore,

       AVG(A.Score) - STDEV(A.Score) AS MinusOneSigma

WHERE A.PostTypeId = 2 AND

sql: WITH post_age_and_views AS (SELECT id, CAST(viewcount AS REAL) AS viewcount, CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 60 AS BIGINT) / 1440.0 AS age_in_days FROM posts WHERE posttypeid = 1), stats AS (SELECT CAST(MAX(age_in_days) AS REAL) AS max_age, CAST(COUNT(1) AS REAL) AS num_posts, CAST(MAX(viewcount) AS REAL) AS max_views FROM post_age_and_views), binned AS (SELECT CEIL((age_in_days / s.max_age) / 0.05) AS bin, viewcount FROM post_age_and_views JOIN stats AS s ON 1 = 1) SELECT bin, AVG(viewcount) / MAX(max_views) AS "average view count (% of max)", COUNT(*) / MAX(num_posts) AS "posts in bin (% of total)" FROM binned JOIN stats ON 1 = 1 GROUP BY bin ORDER BY bin ASC NULLS FIRST
original:
WITH 
  post_age_and_views as (
    select
      id,
      cast(viewcount as float) as viewcount,
      datediff(minute, creationdate, GetDate()) / 1440.0 as age_in_days
    from posts
    where posttypeid = 1
  ),
  stats as (
    select
      cast(max(age_in_days) as float) as max_age,
      cast(count(1) as float) as num_posts,
      cast(max(viewcount) as float) as max_views
    from
      post_age_and_views
  ),
  binned as (
    select
      ceiling((age_in_days / s.max_age) / 0.05) as bin,
      viewcount
    from
      post_age_and_views
        join
      stats s on 1=1
  )
select
  bin,
  avg(viewcount) / max(max_views) as [Average view count (% of max)],
  count(*) / max(num_posts) as [Posts in bin (% of total)]
from
  binned
    join
  stats on 1=1
group by bin
order by bin asc

  from Posts
  group by year(CreationDate), month(CreationDate)

sql: WITH mytags AS (SELECT t.tagname AS name, COUNT(pt.tagid) AS total, (SELECT COUNT(p.id) FROM posts AS p INNER JOIN posttags AS pt2 ON pt2.tagid = t.id WHERE p.id = pt2.postid AND NOT p.closeddate IS NULL) AS closedtotal FROM tags AS t INNER JOIN posttags AS pt ON pt.tagid = t.id GROUP BY t.tagname, t.id) SELECT t.name AS tagname, t.total AS total, t.closedtotal AS closed, (100. * t.closedtotal / t.total) AS "%" FROM mytags AS t ORDER BY "%" DESC NULLS LAST

WITH  myTags as (
  select 
    t.TagName as Name,
    count(pt.TagId) as Total,
    (select count (p.Id) from Posts p
     inner join PostTags pt2 on pt2.TagId = t.Id
     where p.Id = pt2.PostId and p.ClosedDate is not null)
    as ClosedTotal
  from Tags t
  inner join PostTags pt on pt.TagId = t.Id
  group by t.TagName, t.Id
)

select
  t.Name as TagName,
  t.Total as Total,
  t.ClosedTotal as Closed,
  (100. * t.closedTotal / t.Total) as [%]
from myTags t
order by [%] desc

sql: SELECT fp.owneruserid AS "user link", p1.id AS "post link", p1.score, CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(b.date AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(p1.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) AS daystogoodbadge FROM (SELECT p.owneruserid, MIN(p.creationdate) AS datefirstpost FROM posts AS p WHERE p.posttypeid = 1 GROUP BY p.owneruserid) AS fp INNER JOIN posts AS p1 ON p1.creationdate = fp.datefirstpost AND p1.owneruserid = fp.owneruserid AND p1.score >= 25 INNER JOIN badges AS b ON b.userid = p1.owneruserid AND b.name = 'Good Question' ORDER BY CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(b.date AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(p1.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) ASC NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT  fp.owneruserid as [User Link], p1.id as [Post Link], p1.score
  , datediff(d, p1.creationdate, b.date) as DaysToGoodBadge
from
(
  SELECT p.owneruserid, min(p.creationdate) as dateFirstPost
  from posts p
  where p.posttypeid = 1
  group by  p.owneruserid
) fp
inner join posts p1
on p1.creationdate = fp.dateFirstPost
and p1.owneruserid = fp.owneruserid
and p1.score >= 25
inner join badges b
on b.userid = p1.owneruserid
and b.Name = 'Good Question'
order by datediff(d, p1.creationdate, b.date) asc

sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(a.creationdate AS DATE)) AS "year", EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(a.creationdate AS DATE)) AS "month", COUNT(a.id) AS "count" FROM posts AS q INNER JOIN posts AS a ON q.id = a.parentid WHERE q.posttypeid = 1 AND q.closeddate IS NULL AND a.posttypeid = 2 AND a.score >= 1 AND a.owneruserid = 1 AND (q.owneruserid IS NULL OR q.owneruserid <> a.owneruserid) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM posthistory AS ph WHERE ph.posthistorytypeid IN (4, 5) AND ph.postid = a.parentid AND ph.userid = a.owneruserid AND ABS(CAST(AGE(CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST(ph.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) AS BIGINT)) < 12) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(a.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(a.creationdate AS DATE)) ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(a.creationdate AS DATE)) DESC NULLS LAST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(a.creationdate AS DATE)) DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT  YEAR(a.CreationDate) AS [Year],
       MONTH(a.CreationDate) AS [Month],
       COUNT(a.Id) AS [Count]
FROM Posts q
INNER JOIN Posts a ON q.Id = a.ParentId
WHERE q.PostTypeId = 1
  AND q.ClosedDate IS NULL
  AND a.PostTypeId = 2
  AND a.Score >= 1
  AND a.OwnerUserId = ##userid##
  AND (q.OwnerUserId IS NULL
       OR q.OwnerUserId <> a.OwnerUserId)
  AND EXISTS
    (SELECT 1
     FROM PostHistory ph
     WHERE ph.PostHistoryTypeId IN (4,5)
       AND ph.PostId = a.ParentId
       AND ph.UserId = a.OwnerUserId
       AND ABS(DATEDIFF(hh, ph.CreationDate, a.CreationDate)) < 12)
GROUP BY YEAR(a.CreationDate), MONTH(a.CreationDate)
ORDER BY YEAR(a.CreationDate) DESC, MONTH(a.CreationDate) DESC

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1900) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1) AS month, tags.tagname, COUNT(*) AS questions FROM tags LEFT JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id LEFT JOIN posts ON posts.id = posttags.postid LEFT JOIN posttypes ON posttypes.id = posts.posttypeid WHERE tags.tagname IN ('stylus', 'bourbon', 'neat', 'assemble', 'less', 'sass', 'compass', 'scss') AND posttypes.name = 'Question' AND posts.creationdate /* Exclude the current month */ < CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), tags.tagname ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, tags.tagname NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  Tags.TagName,
  COUNT(*) AS Questions

FROM Tags
  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

WHERE
  Tags.TagName IN (
    'stylus', 'bourbon', 'neat', 'assemble', 'less', 'sass', 'compass','scss'
  ) AND
  
  PostTypes.Name = 'Question' AND
  
  -- Exclude the current month
  Posts.CreationDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

GROUP BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

ORDER BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1900) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1) AS month, tags.tagname, COUNT(*) AS questions FROM tags LEFT JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id LEFT JOIN posts ON posts.id = posttags.postid LEFT JOIN posttypes ON posttypes.id = posts.posttypeid WHERE tags.tagname IN ('python', 'r', 'c+|| ') AND posttypes.name = 'Question' AND posts.creationdate /* Exclude the current month */ < CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), tags.tagname ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, tags.tagname NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  Tags.TagName,
  COUNT(*) AS Questions

FROM Tags
  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

WHERE
  Tags.TagName IN (
  'python', 'r', 'c++'
  ) AND
  
  PostTypes.Name = 'Question' AND
  
  -- Exclude the current month
  Posts.CreationDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)

GROUP BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

ORDER BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

sql: SELECT p.id AS "post link", p.score FROM (SELECT p.parentid, COUNT(*) AS contacnt FROM (SELECT postid, SUM(CASE WHEN votetypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS up, SUM(CASE WHEN votetypeid = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS down FROM votes AS v JOIN posts AS p ON p.id = v.postid WHERE votetypeid IN (2, 3) AND posttypeid = 2 GROUP BY postid) AS conta JOIN posts AS p ON conta.postid = p.id WHERE down > (up / 1) AND (down + up) > 1 GROUP BY p.parentid) AS contq JOIN posts AS p ON contq.parentid = p.id WHERE contq.contacnt > (p.answercount / 2) AND p.answercount > 1 ORDER BY score DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT p.ParentId, count(*) as ContACnt from (
    SELECT
      PostId,
      up = sum(case when VoteTypeId = 2 then 1 else 0 end),
      down = sum(case when VoteTypeId = 3 then 1 else 0 end)
    from Votes v join Posts p on p.Id = v.PostId
    where VoteTypeId in (2,3) and PostTypeId = 2
    group by PostId
  ) as ContA
  join posts p on ContA.PostId = p.Id
  where down > (up / ##UVDVRatio:int##) and (down + up) > ##MinVotes:int##
  group by p.ParentId
) as ContQ
join posts p on ContQ.ParentId = p.Id
where ContQ.ContACnt > (p.AnswerCount / 2) and p.AnswerCount > 1
order by Score desc

  SELECT
    Users.Id AS UserId,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN Votes.VoteTypeId = 2 THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS Ups,

  FROM Votes, Posts, Users
  WHERE
    Votes.PostId = Posts.Id
    AND
    Posts.OwnerUserId = Users.Id
    AND
    Votes.VoteTypeId IN (2, 3)
  GROUP BY Users.Id
),
Ordered AS (
  SELECT
    UserId,
    Ups,

SELECT  
       num.TagName as Tag,
       row_number() over (order by rate.Rate desc) as MayRank,
       row_number() over (order by num.Num desc) as TotalRank,
       rate.Rate as QuestionsInMay,
       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
and Posts.CreationDate < '2018-06-01'
and Posts.CreationDate >= '2018-05-01'
group by TagName) as rate

INNER JOIN

(SELECT count(PostId) as Num, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
group by TagName
having count(PostId) > 800)
as num ON rate.TagName = num.TagName
order by rate.rate desc
;

sql: SELECT u.id, u.displayname, u.reputation, n.numposts AS "total number of posts", CAST(u.reputation AS DECIMAL) / n.numposts AS ratio FROM users AS u INNER JOIN (SELECT p.owneruserid, COUNT(*) AS numposts FROM posts AS p INNER JOIN posttags AS pt ON pt.postid = p.id INNER JOIN tags AS t ON t.id = pt.tagid WHERE p.posttypeid IN (1, 2) GROUP BY p.owneruserid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10) AS n ON n.owneruserid = u.id WHERE u.reputation > 1 ORDER BY ratio ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 50
original:

   u.Id,
   u.DisplayName,
   u.Reputation,
   n.NumPosts as [Total Number of Posts],
   cast(u.Reputation as decimal)/n.NumPosts as Ratio
FROM Users u
inner join (
   SELECT
      p.OwnerUserId,
      count(*) as NumPosts
   from Posts p
   inner join PostTags pt on pt.PostId = p.Id
   inner join Tags t on t.Id = pt.TagId
   where p.PostTypeId in (1,2)

   having count(*) >= ##MinPosts?10##
   ) n on n.OwnerUserId = u.Id

sql: SELECT make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)), 1) AS "date", SUM(CASE WHEN posttypeid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS questions, SUM(CASE WHEN posttypeid = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS answers, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT posttypeid IN (1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other, COUNT(*) AS "total", CAST(round(CAST(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN posttypeid = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL) / COUNT(*), '0.0%') AS "questions%" FROM posts WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS DATE)) GROUP BY make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)) AS numeric), 1) AS text) ORDER BY make_date(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(creationdate AS DATE)), 1) NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT  
datefromparts(year(creationdate),month(creationdate),1) as [date],
  sum(case when posttypeid = 1 then 1 else 0 end ) as Questions,
  sum(case when posttypeid = 2 then 1 else 0 end ) as Answers,
  sum(case when posttypeid not in (1,2) then 1 else 0 end ) as Other,
  count(*) as [TOTAL],
  format(cast(sum(case when posttypeid = 1 then 1 else 0 end ) as decimal) / count(*),'0.0%') as [Questions%]
from posts
where year(creationdate) = year(getdate())
group by datefromparts(year(creationdate),month(creationdate),1)
order by datefromparts(year(creationdate),month(creationdate),1)

  from (

    from Posts
    where PostTypeID = 1 and AnswerCount > 0

  ) as q
) as h

sql: SELECT CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * ((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1900) * 12 + EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) - 1) AS month, tags.tagname, COUNT(*) AS questions FROM tags LEFT JOIN posttags ON posttags.tagid = tags.id LEFT JOIN posts ON posts.id = posttags.postid LEFT JOIN posttypes ON posttypes.id = posts.posttypeid WHERE tags.tagname IN ('Kubernetes', 'Mesos', 'Docker-Swarm', 'CloudFoundry') AND posttypes.name = 'Question' AND /* Exclude the current month */ posts.creationdate < CAST('1900-01-01' AS timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' * CAST(EXTRACT(year FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) * 12 + EXTRACT(month FROM AGE(CAST(CAST(TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-15 12:00:00+02'AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP), CAST(CAST('1900-01-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP))) AS BIGINT) AND posts.creationdate > '2010-07-01' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)), tags.tagname ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST(posts.creationdate AS DATE)) NULLS FIRST, tags.tagname NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT 
  DATEADD(mm, (Year(Posts.CreationDate) - 1900) * 12 + Month(Posts.CreationDate) - 1, 0) AS Month,
  Tags.TagName,
  COUNT(*) AS Questions

FROM Tags
  LEFT JOIN PostTags ON PostTags.TagId = Tags.Id
  LEFT JOIN Posts ON Posts.Id = PostTags.PostId
  LEFT JOIN PostTypes ON PostTypes.Id = Posts.PostTypeId

WHERE
  Tags.TagName IN (
    'Kubernetes', 'Mesos', 'Docker-Swarm', 'CloudFoundry'
) AND
  
  PostTypes.Name = 'Question'
  
  
  -- Exclude the current month
  AND Posts.CreationDate < DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month, 0, GETDATE()), 0)
  
  AND Posts.CreationDate > '2010-07-01'

GROUP BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

ORDER BY
  Year(Posts.CreationDate), Month(Posts.CreationDate), Tags.TagName

sql: SELECT LOG(10, CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 60 AS BIGINT)) AS "log time (m)", LOG(10, COUNT(*)) FROM posts AS q INNER JOIN posts AS a ON a.parentid = q.id LEFT OUTER JOIN posts AS a2 /* earlier answer, should not exist */ ON a.parentid = a2.parentid AND a.creationdate > a2.creationdate WHERE a2.id IS NULL AND a.creationdate >= q.creationdate /* negative values can happen due to question merges */ AND /*    AND DATEDIFF(HOUR, q.CreationDate, a.CreationDate) < 24 */ /* AND COUNT(*) > 0 */ CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 60 AS BIGINT) > 0 GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 60 AS BIGINT) ORDER BY CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 60 AS BIGINT) NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT  LOG(DATEDIFF(MINUTE, q.CreationDate, a.CreationDate), 10) AS 'Log Time (m)',
  LOG(COUNT(*), 10)
  FROM Posts AS q
  INNER JOIN Posts AS a
    ON a.ParentId = q.Id
  LEFT OUTER JOIN Posts AS a2 -- earlier answer, should not exist
    ON a.ParentId = a2.ParentId
   AND a.CreationDate > a2.CreationDate
  WHERE a2.Id IS NULL
    AND a.CreationDate >= q.CreationDate -- negative values can happen due to question merges
    --    AND DATEDIFF(HOUR, q.CreationDate, a.CreationDate) < 24
    -- AND COUNT(*) > 0
    AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, q.CreationDate, a.CreationDate) > 0
  GROUP BY DATEDIFF(MINUTE, q.CreationDate, a.CreationDate)
  ORDER BY DATEDIFF(MINUTE, q.CreationDate, a.CreationDate)

  SELECT
    Id AS PostId,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ParentId ORDER BY Id) AS N
  FROM Posts
  WHERE
    ParentId IS NOT NULL
),
VoteRep AS (
  SELECT 1 AS VoteTypeId, 15 AS Rep
  UNION
  SELECT 2, 10
  UNION
  SELECT 3, -2
),
Raw AS (
  SELECT
    PostNo.PostId,
    SUM(VoteRep.Rep) AS Rep,
    MIN(PostNo.N) AS N
  FROM PostNo, Votes, VoteRep
  WHERE
    Votes.PostId = PostNo.PostId
    AND
    VoteRep.VoteTypeId = Votes.VoteTypeId

  AVG(1.0 * Rep) AS Rep

sql: WITH raw AS (SELECT LAG(creationdate) OVER (ORDER BY creationdate NULLS FIRST) AS prevcrdate, id, creationdate FROM posts WHERE posttypeid = 6) SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN prevcrdate IS NULL OR CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(prevcrdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 86400 AS BIGINT) > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY creationdate NULLS FIRST ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS electionid, raw.id AS postid, creationdate FROM raw ORDER BY creationdate NULLS FIRST
original:
WITH  Raw AS (
  SELECT
    LAG(CreationDate) OVER (ORDER BY CreationDate) AS PrevCrDate,
    Id,
    CreationDate
  FROM Posts
  WHERE PostTypeId = 6
)
SELECT
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN
        PrevCrDate IS NULL
        OR
        DATEDIFF(day, PrevCrDate, CreationDate) > 30
      THEN
        1
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) OVER (
    ORDER BY CreationDate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS ElectionId,
  Raw.Id AS PostId,
  CreationDate

from posttags pt -- tags on posts
inner join tags st on st.id = pt.tagid -- SELECTion tag
inner join posttags ptt on ptt.postid = pt.postid -- other tags
inner join tags tt on tt.id =  ptt.tagid -- other tag names

and tt.tagname <> ##tagname:string?teradata##

sql: SELECT num.tagname AS tag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rate.rate DESC NULLS LAST) AS periodrank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY num.num DESC NULLS LAST) AS totalrank, rate.rate AS questionsinperiod, num.num AS questionstotal FROM (SELECT COUNT(postid) AS rate, tagname FROM tags, posttags, posts WHERE tags.id = posttags.tagid AND posts.id = postid AND posts.creationdate < '2020-05-01' AND posts.creationdate > '2020-04-01' GROUP BY tagname) AS rate INNER JOIN (SELECT COUNT(postid) AS num, tagname FROM tags, posttags, posts WHERE tags.id = posttags.tagid AND posts.id = postid GROUP BY tagname) AS num ON rate.tagname = num.tagname ORDER BY rate.rate DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT  
       num.TagName as Tag,
       row_number() over (order by rate.Rate desc) as PeriodRank,
       row_number() over (order by num.Num desc) as TotalRank,
       rate.Rate as QuestionsInPeriod,
       num.Num as QuestionsTotal

from

(SELECT count(PostId) as Rate, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
and Posts.CreationDate < '2020-05-01'
and Posts.CreationDate > '2020-04-01'
group by TagName) as rate

INNER JOIN

(SELECT count(PostId) as Num, TagName
from
  Tags, PostTags, Posts
where Tags.Id = PostTags.TagId and Posts.Id = PostId
group by TagName)
as num ON rate.TagName = num.TagName
order by rate.rate desc

FROM Posts Q, Posts A, PostTags, Tags

  MIN(Question.creationdate) as Question_date,
  MIN(Answer.creationdate) as Answer_date
FROM Posts as Question

WHERE Question.PostTypeId = 1 -- Question

original:
WITH  cw_cte as
(SELECT
  ph.Id AS cwid,
  ph.PostId AS pid
FROM PostHistory ph INNER JOIN Posts p ON ph.PostId=p.Id
WHERE (ph.PostHistoryTypeId=16)
---16 = Community Owned - post now community owned
)

SELECT TOP(##num?100##)
  COUNT (DISTINCT RevisionGUID) AS [All edits],
  SUM(CASE WHEN (ph.Id<c.cwid) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Edits before CW],
  SUM(CASE WHEN (ph.Id>c.cwid) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS [Edits after CW],
  ph.PostId AS [Post Link],
  revisions = 'site://posts/' + CAST(ph.PostId AS varchar)+'/revisions'

sql: SELECT c.post_count, c.cum_posts, 100.0 * c.cum_posts / MAX(c.cum_posts) OVER (ORDER BY c.post_count DESC NULLS LAST) AS cum_posts_pctg, c.cum_users, 100.0 * c.cum_users / MAX(c.cum_users) OVER (ORDER BY c.post_count DESC NULLS LAST) AS cum_users_pctg FROM (SELECT b.post_count, 1.0 * SUM(b.post_count) OVER (ORDER BY b.post_count DESC NULLS LAST) AS cum_posts, 1.0 * SUM(b.users_having_post_count) OVER (ORDER BY b.post_count DESC NULLS LAST) AS cum_users FROM (SELECT a.post_count, COUNT(a.user_id) AS users_having_post_count FROM (SELECT owneruserid AS user_id, COUNT(id) AS post_count FROM posts WHERE NOT owneruserid IS NULL GROUP BY owneruserid) AS a GROUP BY a.post_count) AS b) AS c ORDER BY 1 DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT 
   c.post_count
  ,c.cum_posts
  ,100.0* c.cum_posts / max(c.cum_posts) 
     over (order by c.post_count desc) cum_posts_pctg
  ,c.cum_users
  ,100.0* c.cum_users / max(c.cum_users) 
     over (order by c.post_count desc) cum_users_pctg
from(
  SELECT
    b.post_count
   ,1.0*sum(b.post_count) over (order by b.post_count desc) 
      as cum_posts
   ,1.0*sum(b.users_having_post_count) over (order by b.post_count desc) 
      as cum_users
  from (
    SELECT 
       a.post_count
      ,count(a.user_id) as users_having_post_count
    from (
      SELECT
         OwnerUserId as user_id
        ,count(Id) as post_count
      from Posts
      where OwnerUserId is not null
      group by OwnerUserId
    ) as a
    group by a.post_count
  ) as b
) as c
order by 1 desc
;

sql: SELECT pt.name, p.id AS "post link", 'site://suggested-edits/' || CAST(se.id AS VARCHAR) AS "suggested edit", ROUND(CAST(CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(COALESCE(approvaldate, rejectiondate) AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(se.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) AS BIGINT) / 86400. AS DECIMAL), 2) AS "review time (days)" FROM suggestededits AS se INNER JOIN posts AS p ON se.postid = p.id INNER JOIN posttypes AS pt ON p.posttypeid = pt.id WHERE NOT COALESCE(approvaldate, rejectiondate) IS NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(approvaldate, rejectiondate) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
original:
SELECT  TOP 1000 pt.Name, p.Id AS [Post Link],
  'site://suggested-edits/' + CAST(se.Id AS NVARCHAR) AS 'Suggested edit',
  ROUND(DATEDIFF(SECOND, se.CreationDate, COALESCE(ApprovalDate, RejectionDate)) / 86400., 2)
    AS 'Review time (days)'
  FROM SuggestedEdits AS se
  INNER JOIN Posts AS p
    ON se.PostId = p.Id
  INNER JOIN PostTypes AS pt
    ON p.PostTypeId = pt.Id
  WHERE COALESCE(ApprovalDate, RejectionDate) IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY COALESCE(ApprovalDate, RejectionDate) DESC

sql: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 60 AS BIGINT), COUNT(*) AS "number of questions answered within x minutes" FROM posts AS q INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT owneruserid, creationdate FROM posts WHERE parentid = q.id AND creationdate >= q.creationdate ORDER BY creationdate NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1) AS a ON TRUE WHERE q.owneruserid <> a.owneruserid GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 60 AS BIGINT) ORDER BY CAST(EXTRACT(epoch FROM CAST(CAST(a.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP) - CAST(CAST(q.creationdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS TIMESTAMP)) / 60 AS BIGINT) NULLS FIRST
original:
SELECT  DATEDIFF(MINUTE, q.CreationDate, a.CreationDate),
  COUNT(*) AS 'Number of questions answered within x minutes'
  FROM Posts AS q
  CROSS APPLY (
    SELECT TOP 1 OwnerUserId, CreationDate
      FROM Posts
      WHERE ParentId = q.Id
        AND CreationDate >= q.CreationDate
      ORDER BY CreationDate
  ) a
  WHERE q.OwnerUserId != a.OwnerUserId
  GROUP BY DATEDIFF(MINUTE, q.CreationDate, a.CreationDate)
  ORDER BY DATEDIFF(MINUTE, q.CreationDate, a.CreationDate)

  count(*) AS numPosts

INNER JOIN PostTags AS PT ON PT.PostId = Posts.Id

sql: SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(CAST(q.score AS DECIMAL)) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank, t.tagname, AVG(CAST(q.score AS DECIMAL)) AS "average score", COUNT(q.id) AS count, SUM(q.score) AS "total score" FROM posts AS q INNER JOIN posttags AS pt ON q.id = pt.postid INNER JOIN tags AS t ON t.id = pt.tagid WHERE (q.communityowneddate IS NULL) GROUP BY t.tagname ORDER BY AVG(CAST(q.score AS DECIMAL)) DESC NULLS LAST
original:
SELECT 
  RANK() OVER(ORDER BY AVG(CAST(q.SCORE AS decimal)) DESC) AS Rank,
  t.Tagname,
  AVG(CAST(q.Score AS decimal)) AS [Average Score],
  COUNT(q.Id) AS Count,
  SUM(q.Score) AS [Total Score]
FROM Posts q INNER JOIN PostTags pt ON q.Id=pt.PostId
  INNER JOIN Tags t ON t.id = pt.TagId
WHERE (q.CommunityOwnedDate IS NULL)
GROUP BY t.Tagname
ORDER BY AVG(CAST(q.SCORE AS decimal)) DESC
